show:from beyond.name: From Beyond
show:from beyond.summary: From Beyond is an anthology series with a unique spin on the horror, suspense, fantasy, and science fiction genre.

show:dead of winter.name: Dead of Winter
show:dead of winter.summary: Haunting true tales of murder set in stark wintry conditions; from a body frozen in the snow to a woman who vanishes in an icy wilderness, each mystery unfolds in winter's eerie silence.

episodes:40455.name: The Empty Chair
episodes:40455.summary: The day after a snowstorm, high school freshman Shaun Ouillette vanishes. His mother searches for three desperate weeks. But when an anonymous letter leads detectives into the frozen woods, they make a discovery that will tear the small town apart.

episodes:40455.name: 40 Years Winter
episodes:40455.summary: After Christmas shopping, 18-year-old Linda Velzy vanishes into upstate New York's frozen landscape. The primary suspect refuses to talk to detectives, so Linda's father hatches a desperate plan. But temperatures are dropping and time is running out.

episodes:40455.name: Winter's Bone
episodes:40455.summary: Days before Christmas, a pastor finds bartender Robbie Schmidt strangled in the snow. Robbie's family is shocked when suspicion falls on his closest friend. But as winters come and go, detectives fear they will never catch the killer.

episodes:40455.name: The Widows of Winter
episodes:40455.summary: 74-year-old widow Virginia Johannessen is shot dead in her home; then, another widow is murdered on the same street. Is someone targeting widows on Felton Road? As police unravel the truth, they discover they've made a chilling mistake.

episodes:40455.name: Last Christmas
episodes:40455.summary: Weeks after the Christmas disappearance of 22-year-old Dean Fawcett, detectives discover a headless body in the snow. A handwritten note points to a dangerous set of suspects, setting investigators on a cross-country manhunt to unravel the truth.

episodes:40455.name: Midnight Mass
episodes:40455.summary: In the middle of a cold January night, a family of four is murdered in their home. As fear grips the small town of Evansville, Indiana, detectives launch a desperate manhunt for a deranged killer. But will they be too late?

episodes:40455.name: As He Lay Frozen
episodes:40455.summary: On a freezing Minnesota night, a shooting leaves a young police officer fighting for his life by the roadside; as his wife awaits his fate, a heart-stopping manhunt ensues.

episodes:40455.name: Cold Blue
episodes:40455.summary: Kay Weden finds her mother inexplicably murdered inside her own home. Then, investigators discover the frozen remains of her boyfriend in the icy peaks of Blue Ridge Mountains. Only by speaking with Kay do investigators realize she's being stalked.

episodes:40455.name: Frozen Waters
episodes:40455.summary: A woman and her two young children go missing, then two other boys also disappear, prompting investigators to ask whether there's a serial predator on the loose in the wintry landscape of rural Missouri.

episodes:40455.name: Icy Depths
episodes:40455.summary: Noel Alkaramla, 21, vanishes just before Thanksgiving; investigators interrogate Noel's girlfriend and many others, but the answers can only be found in the icy depths of the Hudson River.

episodes:40455.name: The Killing Field
episodes:40455.summary: A teenage couple disappears from a Colorado neighborhood in the middle of winter; their car turns up abandoned and burnt in a field and everyone is looking for answers, but the winter's thaw reveals the truth.

episodes:40455.name: Nightmare in North Dakota
episodes:40455.summary: After a blizzard, a son visits his parents, only to find them murdered. A peculiar local might know what happened during the snowstorm.

show:the last man on earth.name: The Last Man on Earth
show:the last man on earth.summary: The Last Man on Earth is a single-camera comedy chronicles the life and adventures of an average guy - and humanity's last hope - who discovers what life is like when no one is telling you what you can and cannot do.

episodes:620.name: Alive in Tucson
episodes:620.summary: Chronicles the life and adventures of an average guy - and humanity's last hope - who discovers what life is like when no one is telling you what you can and cannot do. The year is 2020, and after a deadly virus has swept the planet, only one man is left on earth: Phil Miller. He used to be just an average guy who loved his family and hated his job. Now, in his RV, Phil searches the country for other survivors. He has traveled to every city, every town and every outpost in the United States, Mexico and Canada, and has found no one. As he returns to his hometown of Tucson, Phil comes to the realization that he is almost certainly the last living being on the face of the earth.

episodes:620.name: The Elephant in the Room
episodes:620.summary: Chronicles the life and adventures of an average guy - and humanity's last hope - who discovers what life is like when no one is telling you what you can and cannot do. The year is 2020, and after a deadly virus has swept the planet, only one man is left on earth: Phil Miller. He used to be just an average guy who loved his family and hated his job. Now, in his RV, Phil searches the country for other survivors. He has traveled to every city, every town and every outpost in the United States, Mexico and Canada, and has found no one. As he returns to his hometown of Tucson, Phil comes to the realization that he is almost certainly the last living being on the face of the earth.

episodes:620.name: Raisin Balls and Wedding Bells
episodes:620.summary: Phil Miller continues to adjust to life as the last man on earth, while settling into his new mansion in Tucson. But his solitary existence could be upended.

episodes:620.name: Sweet Melissa
episodes:620.summary: Phil finds himself in a pickle and has to work fast in order to save human existence.

episodes:620.name: Dunk the Skunk
episodes:620.summary: Phil Miller continues to live in Tucson.

episodes:620.name: Some Friggin' Fat Guy
episodes:620.summary: A man named Todd shows up and could spoil Phil's chances with Melissa.

episodes:620.name: She Drives Me Crazy
episodes:620.summary: Phil Miller continues to live in Tucson.

episodes:620.name: Mooovin' In
episodes:620.summary: Phil finds a cow, but can't agree with the rest of the group on what to do with it. Meanwhile, Carol seizes an opportunity to move in with Phil.

episodes:620.name: The Do-Over
episodes:620.summary: Carol decides to improve Phil's painting.

episodes:620.name: Pranks for Nothin'
episodes:620.summary: Phil can't persuade the group that running off with Erica and Gail was just a prank, so he tries a different strategy to get his point across.

episodes:620.name: Moved to Tampa
episodes:620.summary: Phil's a single man after his divorce from Carol, and his romantic prospects seem to improve when Gail and Erica are now interested in him, but he still worries that other men might show up and ruin his chances.

episodes:620.name: The Tandyman Can
episodes:620.summary: The cul de sac decides to have a re-election for the President of the United States.

episodes:620.name: Screw the Moon
episodes:620.summary: Phil and Carol reconcile their differences.

episodes:620.name: Is There Anybody Out There?
episodes:620.summary: Phil and Carol leave Tucson behind and strike out on their own in a road trip across the United States.

episodes:620.name: The Boo
episodes:620.summary: Phil searches desperately for Carol after they're separated without phones or walkie-talkies.

episodes:620.name: Dead Man Walking
episodes:620.summary: Carol takes a page out of Phil's book when she tells a lie from which it is difficult for her to recover.

episodes:620.name: C to the T
episodes:620.summary: Phil/Tandy finds redemption when he saves the day.

episodes:620.name: Crickets
episodes:620.summary: The population may be small, but it's still big enough for big, dark secrets.

episodes:620.name: A Real Live Wire
episodes:620.summary: Tandy and Todd attempt to solve an end-of-the-world power problem.

episodes:620.name: Baby Steps
episodes:620.summary: Re-population becomes a hot topic with the Malibu survivors.

episodes:620.name: No Bull
episodes:620.summary: Phil 2 finds himself on Tandy's level when he causes problems with the group.

episodes:620.name: Secret Santa
episodes:620.summary: Along with most human life, the virus wiped out normal traditions and holidays. As Christmas approaches, Carol spearheads a "Secret Santa" gift exchange to spread some festive cheer.

episodes:620.name: Silent Night
episodes:620.summary: The pressure is on as Gail tries to fix a bad situation, and Melissa and Todd try to recover from their relationship troubles.

episodes:620.name: Pitch Black
episodes:620.summary: Mike Miller's space capsule careens through the sky toward Earth, finally putting him on the same planet as his big brother, Phil/Tandy (Will Forte). Mike thinks he is the last man on earth, but who knows what or whom he might encounter.

episodes:620.name: Valhalla
episodes:620.summary: The Malibu gang seeks closure after Phil 2's demise, while Todd and Melissa maneuver through the aftermath of her surprise proposal.

episodes:620.name: Fish in the Dish
episodes:620.summary: Carol is back on the campaign for repopulation with Phil, and Todd's juggling act finally puts him over the edge.

episodes:620.name: Skidmark
episodes:620.summary: Tandy tries to host a party for the group and Todd's luck takes a turn for the better.

episodes:620.name: Fourth Finger
episodes:620.summary: With little else to do, Tandy starts a prank war within the group. Meanwhile Todd establishes his dominance.

episodes:620.name: Falling Slowly
episodes:620.summary: Todd has a lot to think about when Tandy and Carol ask a major favor of him. Meanwhile, Gail's wine consumption has become an issue.

episodes:620.name: Smart and Stupid
episodes:620.summary: Todd feels left out, as Tandy warms to having his big brother back on Earth. Meanwhile, Mike learns more about Erica than the group has ever uncovered about her.

episodes:620.name: 30 Years of Science Down the Tubes
episodes:620.summary: Phil and Mike grow closer than ever and the whole Malibu group gets a big friggin' surprise.

episodes:620.name: General Breast Theme with Cobras
episodes:620.summary: The safety of Tandy and the group is in jeopardy as armed intruders storm the Malibu beach near their home, and no one can agree on what to do. While Melissa takes drastic action, Tandy gets a new lesson in fashion.

episodes:620.name: The Wild Guess Express
episodes:620.summary: When Todd suffers from major remorse over recent actions, Tandy tries to lift his best friend's spirits – even if it requires a few white lies.

episodes:620.name: You're All Going to Diet
episodes:620.summary: Tandy sets up a unique alarm system in the house, but Melissa has already put her own safety precautions in place. The whole group decides to enjoy a change in scenery.

episodes:620.name: Five Hoda Kotbs
episodes:620.summary: A post-apocalyptic road trip has everyone at war with each other and Gail is really pushed to her breaking point.

episodes:620.name: The Power of Power
episodes:620.summary: The group continues to search for a new place to live, but someone may be sabotaging their progress. Meanwhile, the love triangle between Todd, Gail and Melissa hits new road blocks.

episodes:620.name: The Open-Ended Nature of Unwitnessed Deaths
episodes:620.summary: Tandy attempts to develop his new friendship with Lewis by learning about his past. Meanwhile, Carol asks Gail for a big favor and Todd addresses Melissa's mental state head-on.

episodes:620.name: Mama's Hideaway
episodes:620.summary: Carol is hell-bent on capturing the perfect family photo and will stop at nothing to get it. Meanwhile, Melissa has a surprising mission of her own, Lewis looks into a new hobby and Gail finds herself stuck in a scary situation.

episodes:620.name: Whitney Houston, We Have a Problem
episodes:620.summary: After finding a mysterious note left by Melissa that says "Goodbye," the gang sets off to go look for her. Meanwhile, Gail gets stuck on a solo adventure of her own.

episodes:620.name: If You're Happy and You Know It
episodes:620.summary: Carol is bummed about Gail's absence, so Tandy tries to cheer her up with the honeymoon vacation they never had. Meanwhile, Lewis finds new success with his pursuits in aviation and Melissa is contained.

episodes:620.name: Got Milk?
episodes:620.summary: The first moments of the deadly virus outbreak are revealed through a special lens.

episodes:620.name: The Spirit of St. Lewis
episodes:620.summary: After being locked up for her own safety, Melissa plays hurtful mind games with the group. Meanwhile, Todd and the group explore medications that might help her, and Lewis goes on a new solo adventure.

episodes:620.name: Hair of the Dog
episodes:620.summary: Todd and Tandy dig deep into Melissa's pre-virus past, as they search for answers about her illness, and Carol adopts a new outlook on life.

episodes:620.name: Find This Thing We Need To
episodes:620.summary: Carol makes a big discovery, enlisting Tandy and Erica to help her track down some answers. Meanwhile, Todd has a major breakthrough with Melissa.

episodes:620.name: Point Person Knows Best
episodes:620.summary: Tandy tries to take charge of a new situation that has unfolded in the group, and Carol is suspicious of Todd's behavior.

episodes:620.name: Name 20 Picnics... Now!
episodes:620.summary: The gang throws a huge celebration canvassing every major holiday, but Tandy and Todd's bro-mance hits a rough patch that threatens to end the fun.

episodes:620.name: The Big Day
episodes:620.summary: Tandy and Gail face off in a major disagreement, on which the whole group must weigh in, and Carol is forced to choose a side. Meanwhile, Melissa, Todd and Erica each have major milestone moments.

episodes:620.name: When the Going Gets Tough
episodes:620.summary: The long term consequences of surviving an apocalypse start to have a major impact on the group, whose daily life is upended.

episodes:620.name: Nature's Horchata
episodes:620.summary: The long term consequences of surviving an apocalypse start to have a major impact on the group.

episodes:620.name: M.U.B.A.R.
episodes:620.summary: Pamela finds her place within the group as they all set sail for Mexico, avoiding the apocalyptic nuclear fallout in the United States. Their course derails a bit when they realize that none of them knows how to actually navigate a yacht.

episodes:620.name: Stocko Syndrome
episodes:620.summary: Tandy devises an escape plan to get away from Pamela and back to Carol and the others. Meanwhile, the rest of the gang encounters a castaway, Glenn, who has been stranded on an island for years.

episodes:620.name: Skeleton Crew
episodes:620.summary: Pamela tries desperately to redeem herself with everyone, as the gang finally reaches Mexico. Meanwhile, Todd is disappointed that Zihuatanejo is not the paradise of which he'd dreamed.

episodes:620.name: Wisconsin
episodes:620.summary: Carol panics when Todd and Melissa leave for their honeymoon and Erica and Gail decide to live on their own for a while. She and Tandy devise the ultimate plan to convince everyone it's safer to stick together.

episodes:620.name: La Abuela
episodes:620.summary: The gang settles into an old mansion previously owned by an infamous cartel leader. While Carol forces Tandy to put down his new toys so they can baby-proof the giant estate, Melissa worries about Todd's physical health and Gail and Erica can't figure out why Dawn won't stop crying.

episodes:620.name: Double Cheeseburger
episodes:620.summary: Carol's pregnancy takes an unexpected turn, and while Tandy feels ready to face the challenge head on, Gail is concerned and wants to intervene. Meanwhile, Melissa discourages Todd's baby fever.

episodes:620.name: Gender Friender
episodes:620.summary: Tandy goes to great lengths to convince everyone he's a feminist. Meanwhile, Carol gets jealous of the time that Gail spends with Erica and Dawn, and Todd tries to be a father figure to Jasper.

episodes:620.name: Not Appropriate for Miners
episodes:620.summary: Todd asks Tandy for parenting advice when he notices that Jasper is acting more reckless than usual. Meanwhile, Carol and Erica realize that Jasper may be the only potential suitor for their babies and begin vying for his attention.

episodes:620.name: Karl
episodes:620.summary: Tandy and Todd stumble upon a new survivor, Karl, who has been trapped in a high-security prison in Mexico ever since the virus hit.

episodes:620.name: Paint Misbehavin'
episodes:620.summary: Tandy and Todd introduce newcomer Karl (guest star Fred Armisen) to the rest of the gang. Meanwhile, the group searches for Jasper, who has gone missing.

episodes:620.name: Hamilton / Berg
episodes:620.summary: After the graveyard incident, Tandy and Todd try to convince the rest of the gang that something is majorly wrong with Karl and something needs to be done. Meanwhile, Jasper is still missing.

episodes:620.name: Señor Clean
episodes:620.summary: Tandy tries being a helpful, responsible adult in order to finally win Gail's praise. Meanwhile, Todd is furious with Melissa for keeping him away from Jasper.

episodes:620.name: Release the Hounds
episodes:620.summary: Todd sinks into a deep depression, leaving the rest of the gang to console him. Meanwhile, Tandy and Carol can't keep their hands off each other.

episodes:620.name: Special Delivery
episodes:620.summary: While Todd butts heads with Erica, Melissa is determined to form a strong female friendship with her. Meanwhile, Carol grows suspicious that a new stranger could be living nearby.

episodes:620.name: Designated Survivors
episodes:620.summary: Tandy wakes up to a shocking discovery that is positive for everyone in the group, but it throws Todd into a spiral. Meanwhile, Todd and Erica share an emotional roller coaster.

episodes:620.name: The Blob
episodes:620.summary: A thermal heat detector reveals a potential sign of life outside of the Zihuatanejo village, but Tandy doesn't want the group to split up to go investigate. Meanwhile, Todd and Erica have trouble seeing eye-to-eye.

episodes:620.name: Barbara Ann
episodes:620.summary: The gang ventures out in search of what they think could be a new sign of life, but are surprised at what they actually find. Meanwhile, Todd makes a few morbid discoveries of his own back at the mansion.

episodes:620.name: Cancun, Baby!
episodes:620.summary: After discovering hidden dangers in their mansion, the group decides to part ways with their home in Zihuatanejo and embark on a new destination. However, Tandy has second thoughts about what they may be leaving behind.

show:the burning.name: The Burning Zone
show:the burning.summary: A team of virologists and scientists battle the littlest villains — viruses that threaten our domestic health and welfare.

episodes:12465.name: The Last Five Pounds Are the Hardest

show:son.name: Son
show:son.summary: After a plane crash, a devoted wife learns that her life and marriage is all a lie.

show:the terror.name: The Terror
show:the terror.summary:
The Terror is an American anthology television series exploring historical speculative fiction based on true events.

The series is named after Dan Simmons's 2007 novel, which serves as the basis for the first season and is a fictionalized account of Captain Sir John Franklin's lost expedition to the Arctic in 1845–1848.

The second season, subtitled Infamy, bears no relation to the book or first season and is mostly set in an American-run Japanese internment camp during World War II.

episodes:8161.name: Go for Broke
episodes:8161.summary: An accident at sea cripples a Royal Navy expedition, forcing its captains to make a dire choice.

episodes:8161.name: Gore
episodes:8161.summary: After a long winter trapped in the ice, scouting parties are sent out in search of open water. One of the teams makes a frightening discovery.

episodes:8161.name: The Ladder
episodes:8161.summary: With something stalking the ships, the expedition's commanders debate their dwindling options.

episodes:8161.name: Punished, as a Boy
episodes:8161.summary: A series of cunning attacks on the ships proves to the men they are not battling an ordinary bear.

episodes:8161.name: First Shot a Winner, Lads
episodes:8161.summary: A strange illness begins to show itself while another more familiar one jeopardizes the expedition's most valuable resource - its captain's judgment.

episodes:8161.name: A Mercy
episodes:8161.summary: With the end of their provisions in sight, officers contemplate a tough, risky strategy while struggling to raise the men's worsening spirits.

episodes:8161.name: Horrible from Supper
episodes:8161.summary: As the men make new attempts to find rescue, a series of shocking events underscores how vulnerable and exposed their situation has become.

episodes:8161.name: Terror Camp Clear
episodes:8161.summary: Deaths under mysterious circumstances create paranoia among the men, and some of the crew may be considering mutiny.

episodes:8161.name: The C, the C, the Open C
episodes:8161.summary: Hope comes in strange forms, and the question of what the men are willing to do to survive begins to be settled in both noble and horrifying ways.

episodes:8161.name: We Are Gone
episodes:8161.summary: The expedition's epic journey reaches its climax as men find themselves in a final confrontation with the Inuit mythology they've trespassed into.

episodes:8161.name: A Sparrow in a Swallow's Nest
episodes:8161.summary: In 1941, Chester Nakayama finds himself caught between his insular Japanese American neighborhood on Terminal Island, California, and his current life as an all-American guy. When extreme circumstances push both his community and personal life to the brink, Chester must grapple with what kind of a man he wants to be, all while someone watches closely.

episodes:8161.name: All the Demons Are Still in Hell
episodes:8161.summary: In the wake of Pearl Harbor, the Terminal Islanders are evicted from their homes by the US Army and must find shelter elsewhere. While Henry, separated from his family, faces injustice at the hands of the government, Chester engages in a paranoid search for answers surrounding the mysterious events of the past weeks.

episodes:8161.name: Gaman
episodes:8161.summary: As the Terminal Islanders struggle with adjusting to their new surroundings, Chester searches for a way to provide for his family and for Luz, and to fend off the evil that he feels is following him. Henry reels from the trauma of his imprisonment. Asako tries to deal with bad omens. Amy takes up a new job.

episodes:8161.name: The Weak are Meat
episodes:8161.summary: Chester, off in search of a better life, is treated with hostility by his fellow Americans. Luz hopes to be accepted by Henry and Asako in their new home as the Japanese American community celebrates Obon, a festival to commemorate the spirits of those who have died.

episodes:8161.name: Shatter Like a Pearl
episodes:8161.summary: The Japanese Americans are forced to undertake a humiliating exercise that divides the community. Chester comes face to face with a man who forces Chester to question his very nature. Luz, stricken by grief after tragedy, is forced to make an important choice.

episodes:8161.name: Taizo
episodes:8161.summary: A story of the past provides insight into the present evil that stalks the Terminal Islanders. Chester returns home to his family, only to find that someone he was searching for is gone. Henry and Asako are faced with a difficult decision.

episodes:8161.name: My Perfect World
episodes:8161.summary: Chester searches for the person he believes can help; a tuberculosis outbreak forces Amy to act.

episodes:8161.name: My Sweet Boy
episodes:8161.summary: Chester and Luz reach a turning point in their relationship; Amy takes matters into her own hands.

episodes:8161.name: Come and Get Me
episodes:8161.summary: The Terminal Islanders return home; the Nakayamas must come together to battle their greatest foe.

episodes:8161.name: Into the Afterlife
episodes:8161.summary: Henry and Asako look to the past to provide answers to their current turmoil. Chester and Luz grapple with their identities in hopes of saving those who are dearest to them. Amy and Yamato-san struggle to once again assimilate into American life.

episodes:8161.name: November in My Soul
episodes:8161.summary: Pepper is defending his girlfriend when he's arrested and committed for an involuntary 72 hour psych hold.

show:killing ground.name: Killing Grounds: The Gilgo Beach Murders
show:killing ground.summary: When a woman vanishes, police find bodies along Long Island's shore. Years of dead ends and overlooked victims stall the case until a new task force spots a suspect hiding in plain sight. With trial looming, insiders and families speak.

episodes:91387.name: Part One
episodes:91387.summary: While searching for a missing woman on Long Island, police uncover a hidden burial ground. As families demand answers, investigators begin to realize a serial killer may have been operating unnoticed for years.

show.name: Killing Grounds: The Gilgo Beach Murders

episodes:91387.name: Part Two
episodes:91387.summary: After years of stalled leads and system failures, a new task force reopens the Gilgo case, unearthing phone records, witness accounts, and vehicle clues that all point to a suspect who's been hiding in plain sight.

show.name: Killing Grounds: The Gilgo Beach Murders

episodes:91387.name: Part Three
episodes:91387.summary: A year of surveillance and clandestine DNA sampling leads to Rex Heuermann's arrest. As investigators dig deeper, other victims are connected as terrifying new evidence is revealed.

show.name: Killing Grounds: The Gilgo Beach Murders

episodes:91387.name: Part Four
episodes:91387.summary: A disturbing document recovered from Rex Heuermann's computer reveals what looks like a detailed murder plan. Investigators add victims and trace links far beyond Long Island. Ahead of the trial, a court ruling reveals the path forward for the case.

show.name: Killing Grounds: The Gilgo Beach Murders

show:mandy.name: Mandy
show:mandy.summary: Mandy is a woman with dreams. Big dreams. Most of all she dreams of breeding Doberman Pinchers. But there are hurdles to overcome before that dream can become a reality.

episodes:49318.name: Jobseeker
episodes:49318.summary: Mandy Carter is a woman with big dreams - and today her dream is to find work. But the only thing available to her is a job in a fruit packing factory, where a big mallet will come in handy.

episodes:49318.name: Susan Bloody Blower
episodes:49318.summary: Mandy enters the local line dancing endurance challenge - only to find herself up against an old rival.

episodes:49318.name: Russian
episodes:49318.summary: After advertising her home on Airbnb, Mandy takes in a guest from Russia - and they soon become more than friends. But can he be trusted?

episodes:49318.name: Fish
episodes:49318.summary: Lola has not had a customer in her beauty salon for two days so Mandy suggests she introduce fish pedicures. Only to buy the wrong kind of fish.

episodes:49318.name: Meat
episodes:49318.summary: It's dinner at Trent Manor. And everyone around the table has a motive for murdering Lord Trent. But who did? Mandy wasn't invited to the Manor, so she's off doing something else.

episodes:49318.name: Broadsword to Donna Ball
episodes:49318.summary: She's lived a life that's full, she's travelled each and every highway. And more, much more than this, she did it Mandy.

episodes:49318.name: The Unpleasantness at Brampton Hall
episodes:49318.summary: Unpleasantness comes in many forms. Like when you pick up an apple from the fruit bowl and find the hidden side has decomposed. The unpleasantness at Brampton Hall is different. So forget we said that. Contains the worst kind of nudity.

episodes:49318.name: Who Are You, Do You Think?
episodes:49318.summary: Mandy accidentally finds herself on the programme ‘Who Are You, Do You Think?', a fictional genealogy programme that is in no way parodying the real-life genealogy programme Who Do You Think You Are? Not at all. We've never even seen it.

episodes:49318.name: Holiday for One
episodes:49318.summary: According to a friend of a friend, if the staff on a cruise start handing out free choc ices, it means a passenger has died and they need to make room in the freezer.

episodes:49318.name: SpaceMandy
episodes:49318.summary: Why is Mandy training to be an astronaut? Why is Mars called 'The Red Planet'? These questions and more will remain unanswered.

episodes:49318.name: Fatberg
episodes:49318.summary: There is nothing more shameful for us as a society than the existence of fatbergs. But forget about that for a moment and enjoy this episode.

episodes:49318.name: The Curse of Mandy Carter
episodes:49318.summary: Apparently if you stare into the eyes of a forest goblin, you'll be dead within a week. Just fyi.

episodes:49318.name: Destination Dundee
episodes:49318.summary: Mandy often has her head in the clouds - normally a disadvantage for long-term success. But in her new role, it is absolutely essential.

episodes:49318.name: Get Mandy Carter
episodes:49318.summary: Mandy's precious me-time is disturbed by an unexpected visitor, whose arrival sparks a series of events that lead her to a new job where she makes new friends - and even newer enemies.

episodes:49318.name: Humandy Statue
episodes:49318.summary: Mandy dabbles in things she does not understand. Which is almost everything if you're Mandy.

episodes:49318.name: The Career Ladder
episodes:49318.summary: Mandy is going up in the world for once. But someone, or something, is out to send her crashing down to earth.

episodes:49318.name: Nandy
episodes:49318.summary: A shocking revelation in the nail bar leads Mandy to confess a dark secret to Lola: there's a skeleton in her attic. Behind that box of old pottery frogs.

episodes:49318.name: The Ballad of Mandy Carter
episodes:49318.summary: Mandy examines the role of the shadowy global elite in contemporary world events.

episodes:49318.name: Petty Woman
episodes:49318.summary: A glamorous stranger convinces Mandy of the importance of the correct paperwork.

episodes:49318.name: Mad Mandy: Fury Road
episodes:49318.summary: Something is holding Mandy back. But what is it? Can she overcome it? Does she even know what it is? Is there anything she can do about it?

episodes:49318.name: Wormhole
episodes:49318.summary: For once, Mandy has the perfect job. The hours are fine, the pay is good, the fag breaks are reasonable. There's only one problem: people. Yes, them again. Can Mandy outwit them at last?

episodes:49318.name: Mand on the Run
episodes:49318.summary: An old friend brings a chance of redemption for Mandy, but also misfortune, death, danger and destruction – a heady mix, especially for a Tuesday afternoon.

episodes:49318.name: Seed
episodes:49318.summary: Mandy's dreams are shattered by the arrival of a mysterious night-time visitor.

episodes:49318.name: It's Not You, It's Mandy
episodes:49318.summary: Mandy is forced to confront a dramatic change to her whole way of life, and she must look for meaning in places where she's either been too tired or too bored to look for it before.

show:the wind.name: Against the Wind
show:the wind.summary: Based on true historical accounts, Against the Wind covers 15 years of Australias most brutal Colonial past. It tells the story of Mary Mulvane, an 18 year old unfairly charged and sentenced to serve seven years as a convict, transported from Ireland to NSW in 1798. Destined to overcome the misery of a repressed life Mary's journey represents a gruelling chapter of the Australian experience. Surviving the hardship and horror of transportation to Australia, Mary faces an uncertain future in a savage land-establishing herself against the turbulent backdrop of Australia's Castle Hill Rebellion of 1804 and the 1808 Rum Rebellion.

A Matter of Life and Death

show:mandrake.name: Mandrake
show:mandrake.summary:
The series focuses on the character of Mandrake, a criminal lawyer from Rio de Janeiro played by Marcos Palmeira. His line of work consists mainly of helping wealthy individuals who are facing trouble with the shadier elements of the local society (such as rich men who may be being blackmailed by corrupt cops). Mandrake's job is to act as a go-between Rio's subculture and his clients.

He works out of a small, but highly respected, practice, where he has a partner, seventy-year-old Wexler, a Jewish lawyer who was Mandrake's late father's associate in the same practice. In it, Wexler is responsible for the Civil cases, whereas Mandrake (as was his father before him) is responsible for the Criminal ones. Completely honest, Wexler often scolds Mandrake, who he treats like his own son, for his unorthodox and sometimes not completely honest dealings and methods.

Mandrake is also a womanizer, often dating two women at once and having numerous one-night stands. Other than women, his other confessed addictions are Cuban cigars and Portuguese wines.

The episodes are punctuated by narrations in off by Mandrake, where he ponders about the many aspects of human nature and life in modern society. Besides that, he also has informal discussions about life in general with some colleagues at a local bar, named Bar do Zé.

show:prevenge.name: Revenge
show:prevenge.summary: This is not a story about forgiveness; Revenge is a show about retribution. Meet Emily Thorne, the newest resident of The Hamptons. When she was a little girl (and known as Amanda Clarke) her father, David Clarke, was framed for a horrific crime and subsequently sent to prison. While serving his time, the conspirators plotted and murdered David in order to prevent the truth from coming out. Emily is now back with a new identity and ready to take vengeance on the people that murdered her father and stole her childhood.

episodes:9.name: Pilot
episodes:9.summary: Emily Thorne is the newest arrival in the Hamptons. By all appearances, she's a friendly and sophisticated "girl next door," but with a dark family history, Emily is anything but what she seems. Seventeen years ago, her father was framed for a crime by neighbors he trusted, and sentenced to life. Emily never saw her father again, and spent her childhood consumed by rage, loss and betrayal. Now she's returning under an assumed identity with one goal - REVENGE -- every social overture a carefully planned chip at the foundation of her sworn enemies. Victoria Grayson is the glamorous matriarch of the Grayson family and reigning Queen of the Hamptons who holds a dark secret -- her culpability in the events that destroyed Emily's life. Conrad Grayson is the head of the Grayson family, a man willing to do whatever it takes to slither out of scandalous situations. Daniel Grayson is the Graysons' son who finds himself unable to resist Emily. Charlotte Grayson, their daughter, fits right in with the "mean girls" of the Hamptons, but is also drawn to boys from the "wrong side of the tracks." Nolan Ross shares a link to Emily's past, her present and her secret. Jack Porter has spent his life helping his father manage the Stowaway Tavern, and when fate brings Emily into his life, he's unable to shake a déjà vu-like connection to her. Declan Porter, Jack's kid brother, is intrigued by the wealthy world of these elite vacationers and finds a target in Charlotte Grayson. Emily's closest friend, Ashley Davenport, is the go-to event planner who hopes to gain entrée into Victoria's good graces and solidify her status among the Hamptonites.

episodes:9.name: Trust
episodes:9.summary: Emily sets her sights on her next target, Bill Harmon, a wealthy hedge funds manager and trusted family friend who testified in the trial that wrongfully convicted her father. She uses her connection with Nolan to her benefit, unbeknownst to him, and also manages to go on her very first date with Daniel. Meanwhile, Victoria's suspicions about Emily grow and she starts digging to find out a little more about this new arrival to the Hamptons. And the situation over at the Stowaway Tavern gets even more dire for the Porter men.

episodes:9.name: Betrayal
episodes:9.summary: With unexpected assistance from her new ally, Nolan, Emily makes it her mission to destroy the political and professional life of the district attorney who convicted her father. Victoria very privately grieves the loss of her only true love while plotting to confirm her suspicions about Emily's past. Meanwhile, Daniel exposes a side of himself that Emily finds impossible to resist.

episodes:9.name: Duplicity
episodes:9.summary: Dr. Michelle Banks, the psychiatrist responsible for institutionalizing her as a little girl, separating her from her dad for good. Meanwhile Jack and Declan face a difficult decision about the future of the bar, and Daniel's college buddy, Tyler, gives proof to Emily's apprehensions.

episodes:9.name: Guilt
episodes:9.summary: Victoria's more vulnerable side shows through when lingering feelings of guilt over her involvement in David Clarke's demise and an unforgivable rift with her daughter become too much to bear; Lydia returns with a vendetta against Emily and the Graysons that will soon come back to haunt her; Now wise to his father's transgressions and a duplicitous betrayal by his friend, Tyler, Daniel decides to make a major life change; and Charlotte and Declan find themselves in an unlikely predicament together.

episodes:9.name: Intrigue
episodes:9.summary: The Grayson 4th of July parties are legendary, but this year's festivities ignite the wrong kind of fireworks when an incriminating surveillance video pops up and breaks the bond of trust between the Graysons and their head of security, Frank. Frank won't go down without a fight, which will spell trouble for Nolan and Emily. Meanwhile, the tension between Emily and Tyler will come to a head, Daniel can't seem to catch a break, and both of the Porter boys make bold moves to get their girl.

episodes:9.name: Charade
episodes:9.summary: The Graysons' 25th wedding anniversary is a less than celebratory occasion when their desire to lay low is interrupted with a high profile story in the paper and a volatile family dinner featuring unwanted guests; the fate of Lydia hangs heavy over everyone, and Frank, desperate to prove his steadfast loyalty to Victoria, digs deep into Emily's past and uncovers too much.

episodes:9.name: Treachery
episodes:9.summary: Emily's plot further unravels, and Victoria's unstable relationship with her family grows increasingly more tense when an unwanted pawn in Emily's game heads to the Hamptons with questionable intentions. Meanwhile, Lydia's memory is a growing concern for the Graysons, and a recently embittered friend begins to play dirty.

episodes:9.name: Suspicion
episodes:9.summary: Having discovered that her most valuable ally has turned against her, Emily desperately reaches out to her mentor for advice. Victoria's worst nightmare comes true when she finds herself totally alone both in her life and her home, while the threat of Tyler's negative influence continues to grow.

episodes:9.name: Loyalty
episodes:9.summary: Emily questions Nolan's loyalty when she discovers a secret of his, but eventually uses it to her advantage in her battle against Tyler. Unfortunately, it sets in motion a chain of events that prove just how dangerous Tyler is. Meanwhile, Amanda makes herself more comfortable in the Hamptons as word of her presence spreads. Victoria regains some power, and things get very ugly between her and Conrad.

episodes:9.name: Duress
episodes:9.summary: An unwelcome and unstable visitor makes a nightmare of Daniel's intimate birthday celebration with family and friends; Charlotte becomes a pawn in Conrad and Victoria's bitter divorce battle, and Emily watches her ultimate plan begin to unravel.

episodes:9.name: Infamy
episodes:9.summary: Emily sets her sights on a new target when a famed author who has deep ties with both the Graysons and the Clarkes returns to town; Conrad proves how dirty he's willing to get when Daniel gets dragged into the divorce; Jack finally let's his guard down with Amanda; and a stunning revelation is unveiled and becomes a game changer for Emily and the Graysons.

episodes:9.name: Commitment
episodes:9.summary: Daniel plans a romantic proposal that may carry dire, long-term ramifications, and Charlotte is devastated when she's forced to move back home with her mother. Meanwhile, Jack's life is put in jeopardy when he's betrayed by someone he adores, and Nolan forces Emily to think twice about her actions.

episodes:9.name: Perception
episodes:9.summary: In an atmosphere of nervous excitement for Emily & Daniel's upcoming engagement party, things quickly start to unravel: Victoria tries to regain the upper hand by using Conrad's own father against him; Jack finds himself wandering deeper into the fray; the rug gets pulled out from under Charlotte, and even more so for Emily.

episodes:9.name: Chaos
episodes:9.summary: The splendor of Emily and Daniel's Fire & Ice engagement party quickly turns to terror when her vendetta takes a dark, unexpected turn, putting those she loves and hates in imminent mortal danger. Meanwhile, Jack resolves to find Amanda and Charlotte takes desperate measures to soothe the pain of her family's betrayal.

episodes:9.name: Scandal
episodes:9.summary: The murder scandal at the Fire & Ice party rocks the Hamptons, and someone has to take the fall. The devastating turn of events call for desperate measures, as the Graysons form a united front, Emily grows more anxious, Ashley steps up for the family, and Jack is not the only one wondering where Amanda has gone.

episodes:9.name: Doubt
episodes:9.summary: Daniel's imprisonment sends Victoria to depths that no one thought possible, as the surprise return of a past love provides a destructive but welcome distraction from her family's struggles. Meanwhile, Jack's search for Amanda grows more desperate as he comes under suspicion for murder.

episodes:9.name: Justice
episodes:9.summary: Whether or not she intended it to happen, Victoria's pawns are caught in the middle of an insidious cover-up and have to pay the ultimate price when Emily discovers the identity of the mysterious man who murdered her father. Meanwhile, Declan's testimony marks the beginning of the end of his relationship with a self-destructive Charlotte.

episodes:9.name: Absolution
episodes:9.summary: The impending release of Daniel has everyone on edge as the press grows more and more hostile; the SEC begin their investigation on Grayson Global; and Emily discovers a new photo taken of her father on the day of his death, leading her to more clues about how he died -- and also to a mystery woman and an ominous new target.

episodes:9.name: Legacy
episodes:9.summary: The year is 2002 in the Hamptons - Emily, who is still Amanda Clarke, is wayward and reckless until Nolan convinces her to read her father's journals. It is then that it all starts sinking in, and Amanda starts staking out the Grayson home, identifying all the Grayson Global players her father described, and piecing together the truth. Her anger builds into determination and focus; this is where it all begins - the genesis of Amanda's ultimate plan to bring justice to her father.

episodes:9.name: Grief
episodes:9.summary: Painful loss forges a stronger bond between Emily and Jack, Victoria forms a new alliance that could seal Conrad's fate, and Charlotte sets out on a vendetta of her own with Declan as her target.

episodes:9.name: Reckoning
episodes:9.summary: With the end in sight, Emily fearlessly pushes forward, closing in on the final phases of her plan for revenge, while the Graysons continue their downward spiral into the rabbit hole of self-destruction. But a big, explosive event leaves much hanging in the balance, courses are altered and even more is left in question.

episodes:9.name: Destiny
episodes:9.summary: In the wake of last summer's events in the Hamptons and with the ante even higher, what will Emily's next move be? Will she be able to manage her heart and keep her emotions from getting in the way of her resolve to avenge her father? The Season Two premiere of "Revenge" airs on the series' new night and time.

episodes:9.name: Resurrection
episodes:9.summary: Things get complicated as Emily continues to delicately weave her way back into the Graysons' lives while remaining tied to Amanda and her unborn child.

episodes:9.name: Confidence
episodes:9.summary: The Graysons are back in the spotlight and at the center of a media storm once again, while Emily's past continues to haunt her.

episodes:9.name: Intuition
episodes:9.summary: Playing with the Graysons is definitely playing with fire, and Amanda learns that the hard way. Meanwhile Emily and Aiden each get blindsided, and the wheels start turning as Daniel begins to take matters into his own hands.

episodes:9.name: Forgiveness
episodes:9.summary: Faces from the past are reemerging all around the Hamptons, and for Victoria and Emily it brings on different kinds of trouble and significance. Meanwhile Jack's sense of duty grows exponentially, and Padma makes a move that could have major ramifications for Nolcorp.

episodes:9.name: Illusion
episodes:9.summary: The ties that bind Victoria and Conrad are tested as they reaffirm their loyalties and commitment to each other. Meanwhile the all-too-knowing Mason Treadwell digs deeper as Emily and Amanda struggle to keep their pasts a secret.

episodes:9.name: Penance
episodes:9.summary: Things get complicated as Mason Treadwell delves further into Emily's past while Kara begins to unravel, putting the Graysons in her crosshairs.

episodes:9.name: Lineage
episodes:9.summary: Hindsight's 20/20 when a flashback to 2006 has Victoria getting a surprise visit from her estranged mother, triggering memories of her tumultuous upbringing. Emily embarks on her first mission under Takeda's training, where she meets Aiden and learns of his revenge path. 2006 is also the year Nolcorp goes public, and Carl Porter gets into hot water when he crosses the wrong people on the docks.

episodes:9.name: Revelations
episodes:9.summary: Nolan is confronted with a skeleton from his past, and Daniel's leading role is challenged as Emily and Aiden weave their way through Grayson Global. Meanwhile, the christening of baby Carl brings new concerns to light for Jack and Declan.

episodes:9.name: Power
episodes:9.summary: Victoria begins plotting a scheme which, surprisingly, involves Emily, while Emily locks in on her next target, and Declan discovers something that may threaten the future of the Stowaway.

episodes:9.name: Sabotage
episodes:9.summary: Fundraiser and wine auction provide the perfect backdrop for Emily and Aiden's next plan of attack, while Victoria strategically plots her next move. Meanwhile, Jack, Declan and Amanda struggle with what lies ahead.

episodes:9.name: Collusion
episodes:9.summary: With Emily by his side, Daniel goes toe to toe with his fiercest business rival, Jason Prosser, to land an important deal that Victoria is determined to block. Aiden takes a very dark turn, and Jack and Amanda's future lands in the unlikely hands of Conrad Grayson.

episodes:9.name: Union
episodes:9.summary: Emotions run deep when Jack and Amanda's wedding reminds Emily of what could have been. Meanwhile, things for Daniel get complicated at Grayson Global, and Conrad begins a new chapter.

episodes:9.name: Sacrifice
episodes:9.summary: Even with threats on their family closing in, the Graysons are in rare form as they put on a bold showing at their annual Labor Day bash. Jack and Amanda sail off on their honeymoon but the seas prove to be deadly, and this time Emily can't control the outcome.

episodes:9.name: Retribution
episodes:9.summary: Still reeling from the devastation on The Amanda, Emily's commitment to justice and revenge is stronger than ever, while the Hamptons mourn the loss of one of their own.

episodes:9.name: Illumination
episodes:9.summary: The queen and king of smoke and mirrors, Victoria and Conrad, make a calculated move, starting a charitable foundation in the late Amanda Clarke's name. But little do they know that Jack is not buying it and has a plan of his own. Meanwhile, Emily's past catches up to her again.

episodes:9.name: Victory
episodes:9.summary: With Victoria enlisting the help of Amanda's foster brother in her charitable foundation, Emily seizes an opportunity to regain some of her missing past while settling the score with someone who had a hand in setting her on this path in the first place.

episodes:9.name: Masquerade
episodes:9.summary: Hamptonites celebrate Halloween with a glamorous masquerade ball hosted by the Graysons, which is a perfect setting for Emily to drag out Victoria's skeletons. Jack steps up his revenge plan and finds an unexpected ally, and Aiden makes a bold move with a gruesome conclusion.

episodes:9.name: Identity
episodes:9.summary: Desperate to find Padma, Emily, Aiden and Nolan must track down the Falc0n's true identity and put a stop to the Initiative while Emily struggles with her future and Victoria fights her own battle after a very exposing interview on "Nightline".

episodes:9.name: Engagement
episodes:9.summary: Emily plots her next move in her new role as Daniel's fiancée, while Aiden struggles with the re-engagement. Meanwhile, Jack learns more than he bargained for, and desperate times call for desperate measures as Conrad's gubernatorial numbers slip after Victoria's big reveal on "Nightline".

episodes:9.name: Truth (1)
episodes:9.summary: A series of dangerous events has been set in motion and it all comes to a head in one catastrophic moment that will change everyone's lives forever.

episodes:9.name: Truth (2)
episodes:9.summary: The devastation leads to a heartbreaking death that will send shockwaves down the shoreline and force Emily to take a hard look at the truth and the path of revenge she has embarked on.

episodes:9.name: Fear
episodes:9.summary: The summer season kicks off in The Hamptons as Emily Thorne's course of revenge is renewed and set against an unexpected timeline. Meanwhile the return of Victoria Grayson's son brings changes and complications to the all-powerful family. And a glimpse into the future shows that the wedding of the century may lead to Emily's ultimate demise.

episodes:9.name: Sin
episodes:9.summary: Emily's next target takes her into unchartered, sacred terrain, now that the former Grayson Global executive is a reformed clergyman. Victoria makes a bold move with Patrick, and Margaux presents Daniel with an intriguing proposal.

episodes:9.name: Confession
episodes:9.summary: With a new lease on life, Nolan throws a housewarming party worthy of The Hampton's elite, but an unexpected guest leads to a showdown that sends shockwaves through the community, while Conrad's mortality causes him to question his sins.

episodes:9.name: Mercy
episodes:9.summary: When Emily's biggest takedown yet crashes and burns, she must rely on help from an unlikely source to investigate what went wrong. Meanwhile, to protect her own future, Victoria makes a bold move to secure her independence.

episodes:9.name: Control
episodes:9.summary: Emily may be losing hold of her plan, and her groom, when Daniel makes a startling statement at the Voulez magazine launch party, leaving her vulnerable and ready to do whatever it takes. And Jack is forced to make a difficult decision for the sake of his family after he finds himself in a new enemy's crosshairs.

episodes:9.name: Dissolution
episodes:9.summary: Roadblocks seem to be mounting for Emily as Daniel's attention is focused elsewhere, Grayson Manor may cease to exist, and two of the most important people in Emily's life start turning on her - leading her to do something very uncharacteristic.

episodes:9.name: Resurgence
episodes:9.summary: Conrad hires famed party-girl turned PR mastermind Bizzy Preston to restore the Grayson family name, while Emily sinks her teeth deeper into her plan and Nolan has a revenge-agenda of his own.

episodes:9.name: Secrecy
episodes:9.summary: Victoria eagerly throws Emily a bridal shower that neither of them will soon forget. And when Daniel grows more distant, Emily has to take drastic measures.

episodes:9.name: Surrender
episodes:9.summary: As the wedding of the century quickly approaches, Emily puts the finishing touches on her final takedown. But the tighter Emily holds the Graysons in her grasp, the more they slip through her fingers.

episodes:9.name: Exodus
episodes:9.summary: The wedding of the century has finally arrived and Emily's master plan is poised to go off without a hitch until enemies unite, bringing new complications and leading to dire consequences.

episodes:9.name: Homecoming
episodes:9.summary: As allies and enemies scramble to learn what happened the night of Emily's wedding, the Graysons close ranks to protect their own. But when everyone's a suspect, it's only a matter of time before they tear each other apart.

episodes:9.name: Endurance
episodes:9.summary: Physically and mentally broken, Emily finds herself more lost than ever while her enemies circle closer. But one game changing revelation will ignite a new path of destruction.

episodes:9.name: Hatred
episodes:9.summary: With tension between Emily and Daniel at an all time high, Emily makes it clear she is not giving up. However, her own instability could put everything she has worked for at risk.

episodes:9.name: Payback
episodes:9.summary: While Emily's mysterious blackouts threaten everything and everyone she holds dear, Victoria confronts two formidable ghosts from her past.

episodes:9.name: Struggle
episodes:9.summary: As Emily's blackouts grow increasingly violent, her only hope lies with the person she betrayed most, while Victoria makes a drastic move to deal with someone from her past.

episodes:9.name: Disgrace
episodes:9.summary: As the notorious Pascal LeMarchal's unexpected visit reverberates throughout the Hamptons, Emily and Victoria go head to head in a very public showdown.

episodes:9.name: Addiction
episodes:9.summary: Emily uses her newly single status to unravel a mystery from the past as Pascal attempts to make up for lost time with Victoria.

episodes:9.name: Blood
episodes:9.summary: Investigations into Pascal lead Emily and Aiden to uncover some long buried family secrets, while Victoria pays a surprise visit to former ally Mason Treadwell as she gets ever closer to exposing Emily.

episodes:9.name: Allegiance
episodes:9.summary: As Emily learns onto the identity of a key conspirator against her father, Victoria sets a trap she knows Emily can't resist.

episodes:9.name: Revolution
episodes:9.summary: As all the Graysons slowly gain the upper hand, Emily is forced to take on a new identity to expose them.

episodes:9.name: Impetus
episodes:9.summary: Dire circumstance leads Emily to take extreme measures against both the Graysons and those closest to her.

episodes:9.name: Execution
episodes:9.summary: Nothing is off limits as Emily and Victoria are dead set on destroying each other. Lives will be lost and fates will be altered, but who will rise victorious?, on the season three finale.

episodes:9.name: Renaissance
episodes:9.summary: As Emily plans to host her most surprising party ever, Victoria finds a way to turn her greatest setback into a dangerous advantage. Meanwhile, unbeknownst to them both, David Clarke plans his next move.

episodes:9.name: Disclosure
episodes:9.summary: Emily confronts former friends and a lifelong enemy in a desperate search for Victoria, while the fallen Queen of the Hamptons finds herself at the mercy of her own darkest secret.

episodes:9.name: Ashes
episodes:9.summary: Emily's life is on the line as Victoria orchestrates a family reunion with deadly potential, regardless of who gets caught in the crossfire.

episodes:9.name: Meteor
episodes:9.summary: Emily is shaken to her core by an unexpected revelation as Victoria sinks her claws deeper into David.

episodes:9.name: Repercussions
episodes:9.summary: With David Clarke back in the headlines and Victoria in control, Emily needs a new strategy to orchestrate a reunion with her father.

episodes:9.name: Damage
episodes:9.summary: Charlotte's downward spiral takes her to a place where even Emily worries she can't be saved as David and Nolan have a very public reunion.

episodes:9.name: Ambush
episodes:9.summary: Daniel confronts Emily about the secrets she kept while things heat up between Margaux and Louise.

episodes:9.name: Contact
episodes:9.summary: Victoria's future hangs in the balance as the FBI closes in and a mysterious new enemy strikes.

episodes:9.name: INTEL
episodes:9.summary: Emily and Victoria learn that information is the most dangerous weapon while Nolan offers up information of his own in order to salvage his reputation.

episodes:9.name: Atonement
episodes:9.summary: Jack is torn between Emily and the new woman in his life, while Nolan and Louise bring Southern charm to East Hampton.

episodes:9.name: Epitaph
episodes:9.summary: As Emily and Victoria grieve, David springs into action to protect his loved ones.

episodes:9.name: Madness
episodes:9.summary: David finally decides to settle his debt to Victoria while Emily helps Nolan with a takedown of his own.

episodes:9.name: Abduction
episodes:9.summary: In order to survive, Emily and Victoria must set aside their grudge, while Jack and David race to save them before they kill each other.

episodes:9.name: Kindred
episodes:9.summary: Emily helps Nolan's blushing bride deal with the skeletons in her closet while Victoria contends with a mysterious new socialite.

episodes:9.name: Bait
episodes:9.summary: When Margaux uses her ammunition against both Emily and Jack, their friendship takes a dramatic turn. Meanwhile, Natalie shows Victoria the true reason behind her arrival in the Hamptons.

episodes:9.name: Retaliation
episodes:9.summary: Determined to flaunt her new fortune in Victoria's face, Natalie throws a giant Fourth of July bash and invites David to be her date. Meanwhile, Margaux steps up her plans to take down anyone who stands in her way.

episodes:9.name: Loss
episodes:9.summary: As Emily fights to clear Jack's name in and out of court, newlyweds Nolan and Louise receive a visit from Officer Ben Hunter.

episodes:9.name: Clarity
episodes:9.summary: Grief-stricken Emily tries to repair her collateral damage while Victoria pursues a fresh lead with renewed vigor.

episodes:9.name: Exposure
episodes:9.summary: Emily faces a promising future as Amanda Clarke until Victoria uncovers devastating new secrets from her past.

episodes:9.name: Burn
episodes:9.summary: After Victoria is attacked, she takes matters into her own hands, while Emily is forced to come to terms with what she really wants.

episodes:9.name: Aftermath
episodes:9.summary: As Emily sifts through the wreckage of her life, even her closest friends worry she has finally gone too far.

episodes:9.name: Plea
episodes:9.summary: Emily enlists Nolan and Jack to help prove her innocence while Ben takes measures to keep her locked up.

episodes:9.name: Two Graves
episodes:9.summary: Backed into a corner, Emily is forced to admit her guilt, but she'll have to decide how far she'll go before admitting defeat.

show:over the top.name: Over the Top
show:over the top.summary: After being fired from the soap opera Days to Remember, down on his luck, eccentric, self-centered actor Simon Ferguson moves into Manhattan's Metropolitan Hotel, which is run by ex-wife Hadley Martin, whom he was married to 20 years prior... for twelve days. Despite her initial exasperation with her ex, Hadley again succumbs to the "Ferguson charm", as do all of those around her. Simon reluctantly plays role model to Hadley's children from a different marriage: precocious 7 1⁄2-year-old Daniel and angst-ridden teen Gwen. The hotel's psychotic Greek chef, Yorgo Galfanikos, also looks up to Simon, having been a fan of his soap opera and films. Also seen are Rose, the hotel's assistant manager, Robert McSwain, the hotel's main investor, Tommy Sutton, a popular jock Gwen fawns over, and Jesse, a geek who is smitten with Gwen.

episodes:53696.name: It's Gwen's Party and Hadley'll Cry If She Wants To

show:dark blue.name: Dark Blue
show:dark blue.summary: Officer Carter Shaw and his team go undercover - sometimes too deep, among the criminals of modern-day Los Angeles.

episodes:937.name: Pilot
episodes:937.summary: Carter Shaw tries to take down a gang leader responsible for torturing an FBI agent and leaving him for dead. He also trains his newest team member, a fetching patrol cop who proves to be an expert prevaricator.

episodes:937.name: Guns, Strippers and Wives
episodes:937.summary: Ty goes undercover to take down a gun trafficker, but he breaks crucial rules by seeing his wife on her birthday, potentially blowing his cover. Carter must obtain a cool $100,000 to protect Ty's mission---and save his life.

episodes:937.name: Purity
episodes:937.summary: The sting is on when Carter's team targets a sly drug dealer with a professional background in law.

episodes:937.name: K-Town
episodes:937.summary: Ty and Dean team up to crush a rough-hewn Korean mob boss, but tension grows between the two undercover men when Ty works cautiously and Dean adopts a rash, less careful approach.

episodes:937.name: August
episodes:937.summary: The team scrambles to rescue an abducted woman before her captor kills her. The deep undercover mission features Ty as a hood, Dean as a security guard and Jaimie risking all by posing as a potential victim. But FBI interference disrupts the case, raising Carter's ire.

episodes:937.name: Ice
episodes:937.summary: The team goes deep in the shadows to trounce a crime ring that is planning a big diamond heist, with Dean and Jaimie establishing rapport with a major player by posing as a married couple. Meanwhile, Melissa informs Ty that she wants to start a family, a development that causes Ty to reconsider his dangerous profession.

episodes:937.name: O.I.S.
episodes:937.summary: The undercover team pursues a crooked yet decorated cop, but this assignment to crush a fellow police officer hits Ty's conscience hard---particularly after his wife floors him with big news.

episodes:937.name: Venice Kings
episodes:937.summary: The covert crew penetrates a turf war between two feuding gangs, one of which is a new and highly dangerous pack that's trying to seize the heroin market. In other developments, Ty's cash-strapped sister is in need of $7000, which Ty and Melissa can't provide.

episodes:937.name: Betsy
episodes:937.summary: Jaimie revisits her dark past when she goes undercover as her former self in a mission to crush a big-shot smuggler. For the case to succeed, she must reconnect with a bygone acquaintance---and ask a big favor of her boyfriend.

episodes:937.name: Shot in the Dark
episodes:937.summary: Carter surfaces as the prime suspect in an undercover officer's slaying. Meanwhile, Melissa pushes Ty to quit his dangerous undercover profession and start a family. And Jaimie's boyfriend lands a new job in San Francisco.

episodes:937.name: Urban Garden
episodes:937.summary: Carter and his undercover team joins forces with a sightly female FBI agent to crush a regional crime lord, but the case takes an ugly turn when Carter's close friend falls victim to tragedy.

episodes:937.name: Liar's Poker
episodes:937.summary: While working with an FBI agent, the undercover team tries to bust a drug ring tied to a Mexican drug cartel. As shadowy Ty slips into the big-money realm of a dealer, a beautiful art-gallery owner arises as a suspect.

episodes:937.name: Shelter of the Beast
episodes:937.summary: In a clandestine sting to squash an infamous drug-cartel king, Carter must masquerade as an adult-film impresario and Dean inches closer to their mark's daughter, a fetching art-gallery owner.

episodes:937.name: High Rollers
episodes:937.summary: The covert squad slips into the world of casinos to snoop into the disappearance of a gambling-addicted law student. It all gets dicey in this high-stakes realm when Ty goes too extreme in his role as a high roller. Meanwhile, Jaimie's risk-taking comes under scrutiny.

episodes:937.name: Brother's Keeper
episodes:937.summary: The covert unit aims to take down the notorious chieftain of an antigovernment militia. They stage a jailbreak and use his brother, now newly sprung from prison, as a pawn to locate him before he assassinates a federal judge. Meanwhile, Ty's job performance begins to suffer.

episodes:937.name: Jane Wayne
episodes:937.summary: The shadowy crew tries to bust a gang of drug thieves who are masquerading as DEA agents. The mission tasks an eager Jaimie to take on the identity of a junkie, while Ty and Dean must work with a sycophantic informant who aspires to be a cop.

episodes:937.name: Home Sweet Home
episodes:937.summary: Carter and his stealthy squad try to wipe out a home-invasion gang. While Ty assumes the identity of a thief, Alex and Carter pose as bait---but the mission is compromised when their target learns about the sting.

episodes:937.name: Shell Game
episodes:937.summary: Possible crooked behavior by a renowned figure in the black community rises to the surface in the wake of a young black man's shooting death. The case turns deeply personal for Ty, whose girlfriend has a tie to the shooting.

episodes:937.name: Dead Flowers
episodes:937.summary: The team slithers into the undercover shadows to bust two drug-smuggling brothers who are using a flower business as a front, but the case begins to wilt when Homeland Security interferes. Yet there's some blooming: Dean asks Jaimie on a proper date. Meanwhile, Ty is conflicted about his divorce, and a game-changing development impacts Carter.

episodes:937.name: Personal Effects
episodes:937.summary: Season 2 closes with the crew advancing on two drug-smuggling brothers, but they hope to pin down a larger prize: a terrorist scheming to smuggle dirty-bomb components into the U.S. Meanwhile, a job opens up in Miami for Alex; a conflicted Ty muses deeply about his divorce.

show:colors.name: Mitsuboshi Colors
show:colors.summary: The "Colors" are three cute little girls who hang out together and say they're protecting the peace of their city. They have lots of fun together, doing stuff like playing games, solving puzzles, and going to the zoo. This anime follows their largely happy daily life.

show:thief.name: Thief
show:thief.summary: Thief focuses on a crew of thieves led by Nick Atwater who find themselves in profound danger and at a moral crossroads. It also follows the unlikely father-daughter relationship between Atwater and his 14-year-old stepdaughter, who forces him to confront the lies which have defined his carefully ordered world. While the crew tries to pull off the most dangerous heist of their career, stealing $40 million from the U.S. government earmarked for the war on drugs in South America, their lives are complicated by the guilt they feel at the murder of one of their own, a crooked cop looking to clean up his own image with a big takedown, and a terminally ill killer sent by the Chinese Mafia looking to settle a score of their own.

episodes:4498.name: Pilot
episodes:4498.summary: Nick Atwater is a thief who has always kept his professional and personal lives separate, but those worlds collide when family tragedy strikes in the aftermath of a botched high-stakes heist.

episodes:4498.name: I Ain't Goin' to Jail for Anyone
episodes:4498.summary: Grief-stricken after his wife's sudden death, Nick prepares for her funeral as tensions mount with his step daughter, Tammi.

episodes:4498.name: Everything That Rises Must Converge
episodes:4498.summary: Roz's murder leaves Nick and his crew without a vital piece of information for the heist, and makes it clear that the Chinese are closing in on them.

episodes:4498.name: No Direction Home
episodes:4498.summary: After a standoff with Vincent and Shrimp Boy, Nick realizes he must find a safe place to hide Tammi. Tensions boil over between Gabo and Jack, and Gabo comes clean about a problem that affects the plan for the heist.

episodes:4498.name: Flight
episodes:4498.summary: The day of the heist arrives, but the plan is put in jeopardy when Nick gets an unexpected visit from Hayes and discovers Tammi has run away.

episodes:4498.name: In the Wind
episodes:4498.summary: With the Feds on their trail, the guys scramble to get the money and themselves out of New Orleans. Nick learns that someone he trusted has turned on him.

show:rush.name: Rush
show:rush.summary: USH examines the world of renegade physician Dr. William Rush (Tom Ellis, "Miranda"), a "medical fixer" who privately caters to LA's elite and whose service comes with a hefty price tag. Though the hard-partying doctor claims that he doesn't make judgments about his less-than-squeaky-clean clients, he's not immune to the ugliness that he encounters.

episodes:1706.name: Pilot
episodes:1706.summary: The doctor runs into an old flame.

episodes:1706.name: Don't Ask Me Why
episodes:1706.summary: Dr. Rush meets different clients in need of a fast, discreet medical "fix".

episodes:1706.name: Learning to Fly
episodes:1706.summary: Rush has to deal with a medical emergency and attempts to reach out to his estranged father. Eve needs to confront somebody from her past.

episodes:1706.name: We Are Family
episodes:1706.summary: Rush's lunch with his stepmother results in an unexpected outcome. Alex's marriage becomes under more pressure to his relationship with Rush.

episodes:1706.name: Where Is My Mind?
episodes:1706.summary: To try and cope with his anxiety, Rush takes any medical calls he gets. Eve discovers how valued she is.

episodes:1706.name: You Spin Me Round
episodes:1706.summary: While attending a medical conference, Rush and Alex plan a guys' weekend. Rush bumps into his ex and treats a politician. Eve tries to start again with Lucas.

episodes:1706.name: Because I Got High
episodes:1706.summary: Rush is introduced to a powerful hallucinogen that changes his perspective entirely. Alex gets a glimpse of Rush's lifestyle. Eve becomes concerned after belongings disappear from her apartment.

episodes:1706.name: Get Lucky
episodes:1706.summary: Rush is not pleased when he learns that Sarah has changed. Eve has some time with Manny and Alex maybe in too deep.

episodes:1706.name: Dirty Work
episodes:1706.summary: Sarah's efforts to find a sperm donor complicates things with Rush. Alex attempts to contain the fallout with his wife. Eve is encouraged to think about future possibilities.

episodes:1706.name: Bitter Sweet Symphony
episodes:1706.summary: Rush continues to be haunted by a ghost from his past. Eve has to deal with ramifications from seeing her ex. Steffi has a shocking proposal.

show:ronin.name: Ronin Warriors
show:ronin.summary: After a thousand years of exile, Talpa, ruler of the Netherworld, returns to claim the Earth as his own. The only thing that can stop him and his minions are five young men and their mystical suits of armor.
