show:kalifornia.name: Kalifornian Kommando
show:kalifornia.summary: Van Hamilton's first ever trip to his mother's homeland, Finland, takes a wrong turn as soon as he gets off the plane. The 23-year-old kid from California was supposed to have a five-star holiday with his girlfriend Rachel. Instead, he is handcuffed and sent to faraway army barracks to be trained as a commando.

show:the mod squad.name: The Mod Squad
show:the mod squad.summary:
The Mod Squad is a police drama that features three young, hip crime fighters. One White, One Black, One Blonde, was the promotional hype line. The casting was intended to appeal to a youthful, counterculture audience. The basic premise was that the youthful investigators were offered work fighting crime as an alternative to being incarcerated themselves. The show's primary premise centered on the three cops using their youthful, hippie personas as a guise to get close to the criminals they investigated. The show was moderately popular during its initial run of five seasons. The show portrayed a multicultural society and dealt with issues of racial politics, drug culture, and counterculture.

The series earned six Emmy Award nominations, four Golden Globe nominations plus one win for Peggy Lipton, one Directors Guild of America Award, and four Logies.

episodes:3847.name: The Teeth of the Barracuda
episodes:3847.summary:
After one of Greer's undercover associates was murdered at a psychedelic nightclub, he puts his newly formed undercover squad of young adults, all previously in trouble with the law, to work investigating, which the evidence suggests was the work of young people. 

Note: Produced as a 90 minute pilot (73 minutes without commercials), this episode was edited for a 60 minute slot.

episodes:3847.name: Bad Man on Campus
episodes:3847.summary: Following the death of a high school teacher, the Squad work undercover at her school to investigate a juvenile car theft ring, and the circumstances that led to the teacher's death.

episodes:3847.name: My, What a Pretty Bus
episodes:3847.summary: The Squad go undercover in a prison to investigate one case but accidentally stumble onto another one involving counterfeiters.

episodes:3847.name: When Smitty Comes Marching Home
episodes:3847.summary: Linc tries to help an old friend, a returning Vietnam War soldier, after he is framed for the murder of a policemen.

episodes:3847.name: You Can't Tell the Players Without a Programmer
episodes:3847.summary: Julie serves as a decoy as the Mod Squad attempts to sting a computer dating service operating in blackmail.

episodes:3847.name: A Time to Love - A Time to Cry
episodes:3847.summary: A photographer wakes up in his studio and discovers his model is dead. The Squad works to clear him of her murder.

episodes:3847.name: Find Tara Chapman!
episodes:3847.summary: A young woman arrives in L.A. not knowing she has meningitis. The Squad desperately tries to find her, but she thinks they're really looking to kill her, as she witnessed a mob hit back East.

episodes:3847.name: The Price of Terror
episodes:3847.summary: The squad searches for the assailant behind the attempts on Greer's life, leading to the kidnapping of Julie in exchange for Greer.

episodes:3847.name: A Quiet Weekend in the Country
episodes:3847.summary: Pete, Linc and Julie go undercover as vacationers in a rural trailer camp to investigate the death of a narcotics informant.

episodes:3847.name: Love
episodes:3847.summary: Pete's cousin Karen turns to kidnapping to gain her parents attention after they are distracted by the new baby.

episodes:3847.name: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Starlet
episodes:3847.summary: When several young, blonde actresses are murdered by a serial strangler, Julie goes undercover as an aspiring actress, hoping to catch the killer.

episodes:3847.name: The Guru
episodes:3847.summary: Posing as hippies the trio investigate the bombing of an underground paper, resulting in murder.

episodes:3847.name: The Sunday Drivers
episodes:3847.summary: Linc is convinced that the death of his stunt driver friend was not accidental. The trio investigates and uncover a drug smuggling operation.

episodes:3847.name: Hello Mother, My Name Is Julie
episodes:3847.summary: Julie's mother, a former prostitute, arrives in Los Angeles to introduce Julie to the man she plans to marry: a bank robber under investigation by Pete and Linc.

episodes:3847.name: Flight Five Doesn't Answer
episodes:3847.summary: While transporting a prisoner by commercial airline, Pete, Linc and Greer face death in a forced plane crash, brought on by the prisoner's foes on the ground.

episodes:3847.name: Shell Game
episodes:3847.summary: Pete and Linc successfully infiltrate a gang of thieves only to discover they are protected by crooked cops and that Julie has become an unwitting hostage.

episodes:3847.name: Fear Is the Bucking Horse
episodes:3847.summary: Pete and Linc go undercover in a rodeo after a movie stuntman is nearly killed by an unknown shooter.

episodes:3847.name: A Hint of Darkness, A Hint of Light
episodes:3847.summary: Blind author Jenny Wills is viciously attacked on the beach by an unknown assailant, who makes repeated attempts on her life. Unbeknownst to her, he thinks she saw him commit a crime.

episodes:3847.name: The Uptight Town
episodes:3847.summary: The Squad searches for Captain Greer, who has disappeared while vacationing in a little desert town, only to find the townspeople not particularly helpful.

episodes:3847.name: A Reign of Guns
episodes:3847.summary: The Squad tangles with a wealthy arch-conservative who is forming a private militia armed with stolen guns.

episodes:3847.name: A Run for the Money
episodes:3847.summary: Pete's girlfriend gets him tangled up in a mess involving her convict father and stolen money.

episodes:3847.name: Child of Sorrow, Child of Light
episodes:3847.summary: Julie poses as an unwed mother to infiltrate an extortion racket that blackmails parents of adopted babies.

episodes:3847.name: Keep the Faith, Baby
episodes:3847.summary: The Squad is assigned to protect the life of a black priest who was defrocked for his liberal views on society, before being threatened by a murderer who is afraid he will break his seal of confession.

episodes:3847.name: Captain Greer, Call Surgery
episodes:3847.summary: Someone is stealing narcotics from area hospitals and Greer has the team go undercover in what he thinks will be the next target.

episodes:3847.name: Peace Now - Arly Blau
episodes:3847.summary: Linc and Pete go undercover as prison inmates to protect the life of a convicted draft dodger (and old friend of Julie's), whose father is a General in the Vietnam War.

episodes:3847.name: A Seat by the Window
episodes:3847.summary: After someone is killed at a bus station, the killer is believed to have escaped in one of three outgoing buses. Linc, Pete, and Julie each board one of the buses to track the possible killer.

episodes:3847.name: The Girl in Chair Nine
episodes:3847.summary: Capt. Greer reluctantly enlists the aid of a psychic to help find a kidnapped coed.

episodes:3847.name: My Name Is Manolete
episodes:3847.summary: Julie takes in a young, apparently destitute, Mexican boy, not realizing that he is connected to a couple of thieves who don't want him talking to the wrong people.

episodes:3847.name: An Eye for an Eye
episodes:3847.summary: Greer falls in love with an attractive widow, unwittingly making her the kidnapping target of a narcotics gang.

episodes:3847.name: Ride the Man Down
episodes:3847.summary: While on vacation Pete befriends a woman who tells him her brother is missing. When she is found dead he's charged with her murder.

episodes:3847.name: To Linc - With Love
episodes:3847.summary: Linc is initially bummed about having to get his driver's license renewed until he meets the examiner. They start dating but a man from her past comes back into her life and causes problems.

episodes:3847.name: Lisa
episodes:3847.summary: The squad is unaware that the writer they are assigned to protect has a split personality.

episodes:3847.name: Confrontation!
episodes:3847.summary: As dissident students prepare to demand changes in a school policy, a black student is found murdered on campus and the Squad is called in to investigate.

episodes:3847.name: Willie Poor Boy
episodes:3847.summary: An illiterate small time crook gets caught when he can't read the sign warning of danger. The squad rallies to help him if he cooperates with the law and snitches on his partner, who is responsible for the death of the security guard.

episodes:3847.name: The Death of Bill Hannachek
episodes:3847.summary: Julie goes undercover as a country singer at a wayside inn while Pete and Linc investigate the suspicious death of a faded country western star.

episodes:3847.name: A Place to Run, A Heart to Hide In
episodes:3847.summary: Pete, Linc and Julie go undercover at Sims College to investigate a frat boy's mysterious death. Pete plays a running back, Linc an African exchange student, and Julie the object of desire for the star quarterback.

episodes:3847.name: The Healer
episodes:3847.summary: The Mod Squad sets to work busting an extortion racket run by a self styled healer responsible for the death of Linc's friend. Julie befriends a wheelchair bound man paying large sums for empty promises that his paralysis will be cured.

episodes:3847.name: In This Corner - Sol Alpert
episodes:3847.summary: When Pete and Linc's friend Sol Alpert finds his business vandalized, he then learns it was done in protest over living conditions in ghetto housing owned by his own cousin. Sol decides to fight his cousin to get improvements in the housing, and with Pete, Linc, and Julie's help decides to bring the matter to a Jewish court.

episodes:3847.name: Never Give the Fuzz an Even Break
episodes:3847.summary: Pete, Linc, and Julie go undercover to trap a suave, charming veteran con man. His latest targets are three gullible elderly widows.

episodes:3847.name: The Debt
episodes:3847.summary: After a young man helps Pete when he is attacked by hoodlums, Pete learns the man's father may be plotting a serious crime.

episodes:3847.name: Sweet Child of Terror
episodes:3847.summary: An embittered handyman kidnaps Julie, mistaking her for the daughter of the woman who fired him.

episodes:3847.name: The King of Empty Cups
episodes:3847.summary: Chief Metcalf asks the squad to find his daughter, who has left home despondent after the death of her fiancé in Vietnam. They find her, addicted to drugs and part of a decadent rock star's coterie.

episodes:3847.name: A Town Called Sincere
episodes:3847.summary: While on a motorcycle trip to Mexico, Pete and Linc are detoured by a biker gang into a border town and held hostage along with all of the town's residents. The gang refuses to leave until they find out who in the town killed two of their members.

episodes:3847.name: The Exile
episodes:3847.summary: Julie's romance with a charming foreign exchange student turns dangerous when it's revealed that he's really a Middle Eastern Prince who's targeted for assassination by emissaries from his country.

episodes:3847.name: Survival House
episodes:3847.summary: A founder of a halfway house for drug addicts is wrongfully accused of statutory rape of a minor. Pete and Linc work undercover as tenants to find the person who framed him.

episodes:3847.name: Mother of Sorrow
episodes:3847.summary: Pete's fraternity brother Curtis Bell casually tells him that he's going to kill a girl. When that very girl is found murdered, the trio investigate. Curtis happily tells them just how the murder was committed. But Pete and the others wonder if he really killed her, or is just trying to get attention from his neglectful mother.

episodes:3847.name: The Deadly Sin
episodes:3847.summary: A set of rosary beads found on a corpse are traced to a young novice, who witnessed her father, a Syndicate figure, commit the murder. The Squad tries to help her sort out the situation, while higher-up mobsters from out of state plot to kill the girl.

episodes:3847.name: A Time for Remembering
episodes:3847.summary: As the trio reminisces over two years together, and Pete considers quitting the group to work with his father, an old nemesis arrives: Beau Graves, one of those they helped put in jail in the premier episode. He has just been paroled and has come seeking revenge against the trio.

episodes:3847.name: Return to Darkness, Return to Light
episodes:3847.summary: Janny Wills, first introduced in the first season episode "A Hint Of Darkness, A Hint Of Light", invites Linc, Pete, and Julie to meet her new fiancé, Dr. Frank Tarver. Tarver doesn't tell them that he is being threatened by a man blaming him for his daughter's death. But when the trio investigates further, they find that Tarver may not be who he seems.

episodes:3847.name: Call Back Yesterday
episodes:3847.summary: Pete visits his Beverly Hills home to try to help his old girlfriend, who believes her father is being kept in a mental ward against his will and manipulated by her uncle and cousin. While there, Pete also reunites with his mother.

episodes:3847.name: Should Auld Acquaintance Be Forgot!
episodes:3847.summary: The Squad goes undercover on a movie set to aid a director whose film is being sabotaged. The film is based on a real life murder case from twenty years before that Greer worked on.

episodes:3847.name: The Loser
episodes:3847.summary: After he tries to stop a runaway car, the son of a former cop and friend of Captain Greer is charged with stealing the vehicle. Then it is learned that the car, which belonged to a judicial candidate's campaign worker, was also involved in a hit and run. The trio goes undercover at the candidate's headquarters to further investigate.

episodes:3847.name: Long Road Home
episodes:3847.summary: Pete falls in love with a young woman he has injured in an auto chase involving a robbery suspect, only to learn she is the sister of the suspect.

episodes:3847.name: See the Eagles Dying
episodes:3847.summary: A friend of Captain Greer asks the trio to help find out what's bothering his daughter, who has been acting strangely since she's been associating with a group of motorcyclists who also engage in skydiving. The group let an old derelict go with them on a dive and jump, but the old man never opened his parachute.

episodes:3847.name: Who Are the Keepers, Who Are the Inmates?
episodes:3847.summary: Linc receives a desperate call from an old friend, now an inmate at a mental institution. Shortly afterward, the friend is dead of "heart failure", only the latest of a number of strange deaths at the place. Linc goes undercover as a patient at the institution, hoping to find out what's going on.

episodes:3847.name: 'A' Is for Annie
episodes:3847.summary: Julie comes to the assistance of her old teacher, who is being targeted by others in her community for teaching sex education in school.

episodes:3847.name: The Song of Willie
episodes:3847.summary: Linc works undercover as an assistant to his childhood friend, movie star Willie Rush, after an attempt on his life with an ill timed car bomb on the movie set. But concerning Linc more was Willie's cavalier lifestyle and attitude, created in part due to Willie's fear that he may have Huntington's disease.

episodes:3847.name: Search and Destroy
episodes:3847.summary: A hard nosed ex-cop returns from Vietnam to investigate the death of his brother, who was killed in a car accident just after he called him and told him that he had seen a murder, and that the murderer was an undercover cop.

episodes:3847.name: Just Ring the Bell Once
episodes:3847.summary: The trio becomes involved in the case of a young boy who's being raised in an orphanage. His mother is not taking care of him, but she does not want to give him up for adoption, and she is involved with a drug dealer.

episodes:3847.name: Welcome to the Human Race, Levi Frazee!
episodes:3847.summary: Pete and the Squad try to clear a young Apache falsely accused of murdering a man in a small desert town.

episodes:3847.name: A Far Away Place So Near
episodes:3847.summary: Linc comes to the airport to meet a friend who is returning from Vietnam, only to learn that he was killed by a sniper on the day he was supposed to go home. Suspicious of the story of how his friend died, he wonders if any of the four other servicemen in his unit who have returned know more than they are telling.

episodes:3847.name: A Time of Hyacinths
episodes:3847.summary: Julie becomes involved with a mysterious stranger, a movie actor believed to have died twenty years earlier.

episodes:3847.name: The Judas Trap
episodes:3847.summary: The head of a local campus ROTC is murdered, and the main suspect is the man's mentally disabled teenage son, whom he had frequently beaten. However, Pete and Linc, who have befriended the youth, believe he is innocent.

episodes:3847.name: Fever
episodes:3847.summary: A man on the run, with the son he doesn't have legal custody of, kidnaps Julie. However, as both have Rocky Mountain spotted fever, she is more concerned for their lives than hers.

episodes:3847.name: Is There Anyone Left In Santa Paula?
episodes:3847.summary: Following a death of an immigration agent at a car wash where an undocumented immigrant (and a friend of Pete's) work, the Squad finds a cop involved in the illegal entry of Mexican youths across the border - all tied to a village in Sonora. The officer and Greer are at odds on how to handle the case.

episodes:3847.name: A Short Course in War
episodes:3847.summary: An attention starved misfit gunman hell bent on starting a "war" with the establishment, infiltrates a student protest with Julie trapped as one of the hostages. Also among the hostages is her humanities teacher, who has a heart condition but left her medication in her car.

episodes:3847.name: Kicks Incorporated
episodes:3847.summary: The Squad investigates a unique nuisance racket headed by a man who turns out to be a close friend of Greer's.

episodes:3847.name: A Bummer for R.J.
episodes:3847.summary: Carl Betz plays a disillusioned solid citizen who becomes involved in the death of a hippie girl. He's seeking the girl's killer while his heartsick daughter searches desperately for him.

episodes:3847.name: The Hot, Hot Car
episodes:3847.summary: A car belonging to a businessman's associate has been stolen. However, the investigation becomes dire after Greer learns that that car was rigged with dynamite, as the businessman wanted to commit murder. The Squad rush to find the car before the dynamite explodes at 5 p.m., potentially killing an innocent family who rented it.

episodes:3847.name: Suffer, Little Children
episodes:3847.summary: The Squad helps a minister find out who murdered his brother, a psychologist who ran a clinic for troubled youngsters. Besides differing ideologies, complicating matters was that the clinic was used to hold stolen goods before they are fenced.

episodes:3847.name: Is That Justice? No, It's the Law
episodes:3847.summary: Greer and another veteran cop have both been frustrated by a drug pusher they've been trying to nail, who has twice had his case dismissed on legal technicalities. Finally, the third time appears to be the clincher, as the man is caught at an airport with a case full of heroin.

episodes:3847.name: A Double for Danger
episodes:3847.summary: A girl working undercover for a cop trying to bring down a drug lord is accidentally killed. Because of her resemblance to the dead girl, Julie is quickly recruited to impersonate her and continue in the mission, despite the great risk.

episodes:3847.name: Welcome to Our City
episodes:3847.summary: The trio tries to help a boy in his search for his father, who came to L.A. from West Virginia hoping to find work. It soon becomes apparent that there are people who don't want them to find the man, and that he is in debt to loan sharks.

episodes:3847.name: The Comeback
episodes:3847.summary: The Squad helps the son of an aging ex-boxing champ who is being harassed by gamblers for inside information on his dad's return to the ring after an 11-year absence.

episodes:3847.name: We Spy
episodes:3847.summary: While working undercover as safe crackers, Pete and Linc meet a timid, clumsy young man who asks them to teach him about their trade. They learn that the young man has a twin brother who is a successful businessman. What they don't know is that the businessman is actually the leader of the industrial spying ring they are trying to investigate. And that's only the start of the surprises to come.

episodes:3847.name: The Price of Love
episodes:3847.summary: When his motorcycle breaks down on a trip, Linc stops in an abandoned town, only to discover that a kidnapped boy is being held there for ransom. The kidnappers decide to hold Linc as well until they get the money.

episodes:3847.name: The Sentinels
episodes:3847.summary: While searching for a pair of murderers, the trio uncovers a link between murder, a stolen car and a threatened epidemic.

episodes:3847.name: Cricket
episodes:3847.summary: Julie and a young boy named Cricket go to the park where Cricket finds a gun dropped by a man he runs into. Cricket then accidentally shoots Julie and, thinking he's killed her, runs away.

episodes:3847.name: Home Is the Streets
episodes:3847.summary: The Squad pursues a dope pusher on the run for shooting two policemen.

episodes:3847.name: Survival
episodes:3847.summary: After Julie picks up a blind hitchhiker, they have a flat tire and flag down a passing car for help. Unfortunately, the people in the car trick them into switching cars and abandon them in the desert.

episodes:3847.name: Color of Laughter, Color of Tears
episodes:3847.summary: The Squad investigates a circus carnival that is being sabotaged before its opening day. The circus' owner vows the show will go on, despite it being in more danger of additional accidents.

episodes:3847.name: The Medicine Men
episodes:3847.summary: Julie falls in love with a young doctor who is being blackmailed by one of his fellow students from medical school.

episodes:3847.name: The Sands of Anger
episodes:3847.summary: Julie, Linc and Pete attend a dune buggy race where a pickup truck blows up, killing a young man Julie had just met. The trio then investigate the incident, suspecting foul play.

episodes:3847.name: The Poisoned Mind
episodes:3847.summary: Depressed after having shot a young man during a burglary, Greer takes time off to recover. However, while on vacation, he found himself poisoned by a slow acting poison that could kill him, leading to the Squad to go on a race against time to find the criminal.

episodes:3847.name: Exit the Closer
episodes:3847.summary: The trio helps a used car salesman who's made a deal with the devil.

episodes:3847.name: Whatever Happened to Linc Hayes?
episodes:3847.summary: Suffering from amnesia after getting mugged, Linc wanders Skid Row, unsure as to whether or not he is the escaped mental patient he reads about in a newspaper. The second clip show of the series, which includes flashbacks to previous episodes Bad Man on Campus, My, What a Pretty Bus, and Who Are the Keepers, Who Are the Inmates?

episodes:3847.name: And a Little Child Shall Bleed Them
episodes:3847.summary: The Squad tries to protect a TV clown whose life is in danger.

episodes:3847.name: The Loser
episodes:3847.summary: The Squad defends a drug dealer, whose daughter is a sick child in need of medical care; his associate has marked him for murder.

episodes:3847.name: Death of a Nobody
episodes:3847.summary: A woman is killed by a hit and run driver, but Pete is sure he was the intended victim.

episodes:3847.name: Feet of Clay
episodes:3847.summary: A young deaf-mute is credited as a hero after he saves a guard from a warehouse fire just as Pete, Linc, and Julie come upon the scene. But someone is trying to kill the young man, who seems ashamed by all the attention he's getting, and may know more than he's letting on.

episodes:3847.name: I Am My Brother's Keeper
episodes:3847.summary: Linc, Julie, and Greer race against time to find Pete, who has left the hospital prematurely after being run down by a car. He is determined to find out who murdered the friend he was meeting, and is unaware that he has a dangerous blood clot which could kill him. The killers of his friend are also looking for Pete, planning to kill him as well.

episodes:3847.name: Deal with the Devil
episodes:3847.summary: Pete is contacted by his old friend Rusty Bryson, a war correspondent whom he knew and idolized as a boy. But the Treasury department is looking for Bryson, who it suspects of smuggling drugs from Vietnam.

episodes:3847.name: Kill Gently, Sweet Jessie
episodes:3847.summary: A convicted murderer out on parole goes on a mission to kill Pete, who he mistakenly believes was responsible for a savage beating he suffered years earlier.

episodes:3847.name: Shockwave
episodes:3847.summary: Julie becomes emotionally attached to an abandoned baby whose parents are terrorizing the area with armed robberies.

episodes:3847.name: No More Oak Leaves for Ernie Holland
episodes:3847.summary: A Vietnam veteran returns to the police force with questionable ideas of dealing with dissident ghetto residents.

episodes:3847.name: The Cave
episodes:3847.summary: Julie, Linc and Pete break down in the desert during a sandstorm and seek shelter in an abandoned mine. An old man embittered by the death of his son in the war who hates hippies then sets off dynamite and traps the trio inside.

episodes:3847.name: The Wild Weekend
episodes:3847.summary: Pete is kidnapped and almost killed by the jealous boyfriend of his former fiancée.

episodes:3847.name: The Tangled Web
episodes:3847.summary: Pete and Linc come close to breaking the law as they attempt to help a parolee, an old friend of Julie's, return stolen jewelry.

episodes:3847.name: Outside Position
episodes:3847.summary: A stable boy's employer frames him for possessing drugs and continues conspiring against him after his parole, all in order to stop the young man's romance with his daughter.

episodes:3847.name: Big George
episodes:3847.summary: A man happens to witness the murder of a sales clerk and agrees to testify at the trial. As a result he and his family are relentlessly terrorized by someone, even after the trial has ended.

episodes:3847.name: The Connection (1)
episodes:3847.summary: When Greer is seriously hurt by phony cops (one of these a drug dealer whom Greer had previously apprehended), and four suitcases of heroin belonging to a crime syndicate are stolen, Sgt. Ed Lassiter leads the Squad on their most challenging assignment ever, looking at every possible connection.

episodes:3847.name: The Connection (2)
episodes:3847.summary: Pete and Julie risk their lives gathering evidence of the syndicate's plan of distributing the heroin while attending an upscale party of one of its henchmen. And Sgt. Lassiter harbors a dark secret that would not only affect his career, but also his future.

episodes:3847.name: The Thunder Makers
episodes:3847.summary: The Squad investigates when a youth joins a motorcycle gang, plots a fake payroll robbery of his father's company and learns the other gang members are playing it for real.

episodes:3847.name: Yesterday's Ashes
episodes:3847.summary: The Squad witnesses a shoplifting by a badly scarred woman and arranges plastic surgery, believing it would prevent her from a life of crime.

episodes:3847.name: A Gift for Jenny
episodes:3847.summary: A fur coat is the only lead the trio has in a case involving kidnapping and murder that has them baffled.

episodes:3847.name: Taps, Play It Louder
episodes:3847.summary: The trio searches for Julie's cousin, a Vietnam veteran who missed his stop when he took the bus home.

episodes:3847.name: Eyes of the Beholder
episodes:3847.summary: The brother of a fur thief attempts to kill Pete, holding him responsible for his brother's death. Meanwhile, a blind childhood friend of Pete's returns home for an operation that would give her the ability to see, although her surgeon fears the positive results may not be permanent.

episodes:3847.name: Good Times Are Just Memories
episodes:3847.summary: A police lieutenant involved in a jewel theft ring murders an informer and plants evidence implicating Pete as the killer.

episodes:3847.name: Corbey
episodes:3847.summary: When Greer is framed as being on the take, the Squad begins an investigation to clear his name. Complicating things is a boy who became handicapped after being injured by Greer a few years earlier during a shootout.

episodes:3847.name: Can You Hear Me Out There?
episodes:3847.summary: A rash of car thefts appear to be connected to a particular radio station and a puzzling code. Pete becomes friends with the car thief while Julie and Linc check out the station.

episodes:3847.name: Another Final Game
episodes:3847.summary: When a con man takes a little old lady friend of Linc's for $600, Pete and Julie assume the roles of a wealthy young couple to lure the bad guy.

episodes:3847.name: Crime Club
episodes:3847.summary: The Squad matches wits with a group of students with genius IQs responsible for bizarre headline making robberies.

episodes:3847.name: The Twain
episodes:3847.summary: A Korean girl finds trouble in her search for her American father. Pete accidentally hits her with his car after she runs from the scene of a murder she witnessed, and the killers are still after her.

episodes:3847.name: Belinda -- End of Little Miss Bubble Gum
episodes:3847.summary:
The squad must determine if a former child star is a klutz or a target for murder.

Note: Songs "Bitter Weeds" and "Take Me Along", words and music by Peggy Lipton.

episodes:3847.name: Kristie
episodes:3847.summary: A little girl's father gets in trouble with jewel thieves just before Christmas. He leaves his daughter with Pete, an old friend, but then doesn't return for her as promised, and the trio tries to find him.

episodes:3847.name: Sanctuary
episodes:3847.summary: Julie is hit by a truck after collecting evidence against a mobster. Though her injuries are not serious, she is kept in the hospital for her protection. But she is still in danger from people working for the syndicate who want to keep her from testifying.

episodes:3847.name: Run, Lincoln, Run
episodes:3847.summary: A friend of Linc's is caught in the clutches of loan sharks and forced to set Linc up for elimination.

episodes:3847.name: Don't Kill My Child
episodes:3847.summary: Although a stepfather confesses to child beating, the Squad believes the mother is guilty.

episodes:3847.name: Death in High Places
episodes:3847.summary: Linc takes an undercover job as a high steel construction worker to find his friend's murderer.

episodes:3847.name: Put Out the Welcome Mat for Death
episodes:3847.summary: The trio investigates a euthanasia that may turn out to be murder. The accused man, who killed his terminally ill wife, claims she was in intolerable pain, but doctors say she was receiving too much morphine to be suffering that much.

episodes:3847.name: Scion of Death
episodes:3847.summary: Pete and Linc witness a kidnapping of a son of a newspaper publisher, but his father refuses to report the abduction to the police. After Greer and the Squad got involved, it was revealed that an ex-servant of the publisher was involved.

episodes:3847.name: The Night Holds Terror
episodes:3847.summary: Convalescing in the home of a doctor and his wife, Julie is terrorized by a man who vows to kill everyone in the house.

episodes:3847.name: Cry Uncle
episodes:3847.summary: The visit of Captain Greer's eccentric Uncle Max, a Greek painter, coincides with a series of art thefts. The robberies are baffling police as the guards can recall no one entering or leaving the galleries.

episodes:3847.name: And Once for My Baby
episodes:3847.summary: The Squad helps prevent a $1 million heist masterminded by an ex-con whose pregnant wife is an unknowing victim of cervical cancer.

show:dark angel.name: Dark Angel
show:dark angel.summary: In the year 2019 the U.S. has become a third world country in the wake of the Pulse - an electromagnetic shockwave unleashed by nuclear terrorists in 2009. This is Max's world, an unforgiving place even for a genetically engineered soldier like her. On the run from her creators and constantly in search of her past, Max joins forces with the idealistic cyberjournalist "Eyes Only". She's a revved-up girl trying to make a run-down world a better place.

episodes:554.name: Pilot
episodes:554.summary: In the series pilot, Max finds her hunt for fellow escapees aided by a techno-geek with a key to her past as a genetics experiment.

episodes:554.name: Heat
episodes:554.summary: Lydecker closes in after Max is reunited with the woman who saved her the night she escaped from the Manticore lab. Meanwhile, strange changes in Max's DNA have her crawling the walls.

episodes:554.name: Flushed
episodes:554.summary: Max goes above the law to secure meds for her worsening seizures and winds up behind bars---and at the mercy of a warped warden with a link to Lydecker. But as Logan and Original Cindy race to the rescue, Max finds a kindred spirit whose abusive past helps her face down a former demon.

episodes:554.name: C.R.E.A.M.
episodes:554.summary: Logan runs smack into his past while helping a client investigate her dad's mysterious death; Max helps Sketchy one-up a two-faced casino owner who bilked him for a bundle of cash.

episodes:554.name: 411 on the DL
episodes:554.summary: A lead on a fellow Manticore fugitive sends Max on a mission to find an old friend; Logan's ex returns, hoping to make amends for past sins; Herbal gets himself canned from the Jam Pony.

episodes:554.name: Prodigy
episodes:554.summary: Logan puts his life on the line to barter for Max's after a hostage crisis at a genetics conference traps Max with a deadly fellow attendee...Lydecker. But as the situation intensifies, it becomes clear that hunter and prey will have to play nice together to get out alive.

episodes:554.name: Cold Comfort
episodes:554.summary: Logan helps Zack and Max track down Lydecker after they tie him to the kidnapping of one of their fellow bio-synths. But when they get their former master where they want him, Lydecker fills the kids in on who was really behind the abduction...and why. Meanwhile, Cindy and Sketchy derail Normal's plan to impress a potential foreign investor.

episodes:554.name: Blah Blah Woof Woof
episodes:554.summary: Lydecker's manhunt for Vogelsang's killer puts Max on too many "most wanted" lists. Meanwhile, a stray bullet lodged in Logan's spine leaves him near death, forcing his protégée to make a decision that could save his life, but end her own.

episodes:554.name: Out
episodes:554.summary: Max and Logan's growing attraction is put to the test as he breaks their first date to bust a flesh-peddler, who makes it his sole mission to silence "For Eyes Only" forever. Meanwhile, the Jam Pony kids catch on to Normal's new lady after he sends a delivery to her domicile.

episodes:554.name: Red
episodes:554.summary: Logan recruits Max to guard a Federal witness who can nail Mayor Steckler, only to find that the man in need of protection is a face from their not-so-distant---and very painful---pasts. But keeping the guy safe proves deadly as a corps of superhuman soldiers steps in to take care of Steckler's business.

episodes:554.name: Art Attack
episodes:554.summary: Max is Logan's date for a Cale family wedding, where the wisecracking crime fighter gets in touch with her softer side, and Logan gets in deep with a lady he used to love. But the big day is dashed for Max after Normal is abducted by an angry art forger who has deadly plans for the man unless someone shows up with his precious pilfered painting.

episodes:554.name: Rising
episodes:554.summary: The Red supersoldiers kidnap Original Cindy (Valarie Rae Miller) to get to Max, whose overamped DNA may be the key to their survival---and Logan's chance to walk again. Meanwhile, it seems like some of Max's best buds are starting to change, and not necessarily for the better.

episodes:554.name: The Kidz Are Aiight
episodes:554.summary: It's a race to save the Manticore fugitives after Zack escapes from Lydecker's lair and enlists Max to help round up their lost friends. Meanwhile, Max finds herself growing even closer to a newly mobile Logan; and Original Cindy gets herself a new place to live now that her old landlord is dead.

episodes:554.name: Female Trouble
episodes:554.summary: Max battles her conscience after catching a fellow Manticore experiment hell-bent on killing a doctor with a tie to their past---and Max's future with Logan. But when Lydecker puts them all in the line of fire, Max is forced to choose between an old friend and her new flame.

episodes:554.name: Haven
episodes:554.summary: A weekend away in a sleepy---and creepy---little town has Max helping a boy who sees dead people and Logan investigating the murders of several political activists.

episodes:554.name: Shorties in Love
episodes:554.summary: Max's plan to steal a set of computer discs is derailed by Original Cindy's felonious ex-lover, who draws the unwanted attention of a shadowy pharmaceutical firm. But once they catch her, it may be too late for Max to save the comely con artist from triggering the end of the world without even knowing it.

episodes:554.name: Pollo Loco
episodes:554.summary: When two corpses turn up with the bar code of an escaped X-5, Lydecker's boss steps in to pay him an unexpected---and unpleasant---visit. Meanwhile, Max springs into action after realizing that her fellow fugitive may be behind the killings and that she is the only one who can bring his hunting season to a close.

episodes:554.name: I and I Am a Camera
episodes:554.summary: Max gets herself a sidekick after a pseudo-superhero calling himself the Street Sweeper strong-arms his way into a hunt for the person offing recently paroled felons. But when Logan uncovers his uncle's tie to the crimes, he fears the Cale family fortune could be nothing but blood money and must decide whom to trust. And whom to turn against.

episodes:554.name: Hit a Sista Back
episodes:554.summary: It's a battle of the bio-synths as Max, Zack and Tinga's plan to stop Lydecker from snagging Tinga's son pits them against Madame X's newest weapon---a brainwashed Brin. But when a double-cross puts them all in danger, it becomes clear that someone at Manticore is keeping secrets about the future of the X-5 project.

episodes:554.name: Meow
episodes:554.summary: On the anniversary of their meeting, Max's cat DNA sends her into heat, forcing her to bail on a date with Logan. Meanwhile, Lydecker and X play a game of cat and mouse with Max that puts her in harm's way and Manticore's top agent on his own boss's hit list.

episodes:554.name: ...And Jesus Brought a Casserole
episodes:554.summary: Madame X's twisted plan for Max forces Lydecker into an unholy pact with a pack of his former "kids" to bring down Manticore. But when things go tragically awry, Logan must make a life-altering choice that could put Max back into the hands of the enemy.

episodes:554.name: Designate This
episodes:554.summary: A rebuilt Max maps her escape from Madame X's lair, as Logan finds an unlikely ally in exposing Manticore and its genetic experiments. But when Max is forced to do her captor's dirty work, it begins to look like Eyes Only's days are over.

episodes:554.name: Bag 'Em
episodes:554.summary: Max takes several child transgens under her wing after they become targets of White's lethal "cleanup" project to bury Manticore's existence.

episodes:554.name: Proof of Purchase
episodes:554.summary: Alec hides his deadly reason for helping Max stop a rampaging Joshua, whose pattern of attacks could lead them right to Sandeman. Meanwhile, Lydecker makes a startling find while digging into Renfro's botched experiments at a demolition site.

episodes:554.name: Radar Love
episodes:554.summary: As a mysterious virus targets Seattle's Asian community, Max and Logan find themselves facing a new foe---and possible new lovers. Meanwhile, the search for Joshua's creator hits a dead end.

episodes:554.name: Boo
episodes:554.summary: Max tracks a deadly---and decapitated---Manticore nomlie as Halloween proves a prime time for the mutants to roam Seattle undetected. But as she and Joshua close in on the headless assassin, she almost loses her own head when it becomes clear that Logan and Asha have been spending a bit too much time together.

episodes:554.name: Two
episodes:554.summary: The hunt is on for Joshua after three Seattle cops are attacked by a canine-like killer; Alec snags a job at Jam Pony as a way to score the money he owes Max.

episodes:554.name: Some Assembly Required
episodes:554.summary: Logan's hunt for a gang of Steelheads reveals a shocking truth about Max's presumed-dead cohort and his ominous mission to make Cale pay for the botched Manticore attack. But when Max sees that her friend has gone commando, she's forced to choose between "family" and her feelings for Logan. Meanwhile, Original Cindy finds the perfect way to keep Normal off Max's back for missing work while she tends to her dangerous duties.

episodes:554.name: Gill Girl
episodes:554.summary: Max and Alec race to save a mermaid from White's clutches after realizing she may be linked to Manticore's fishy genetics project. Meanwhile, Logan has a brush with death after he and Max get a little too close while babysitting his niece.

episodes:554.name: Medium is the Message
episodes:554.summary: A mother in mourning hires Logan to find her missing son, who may have a shocking tie to White...and a woman Logan knows very well. Meanwhile, Alec taps into Joshua's secret skills to make a killing in the art market, but ends up putting Max's medical research in peril after her papers become part of the dog-boy's paintings.

episodes:554.name: Brainiac
episodes:554.summary: Max gets some help from Manticore's plus-sized secret---and smitten---weapon after a mole sets a trap to silence Asha's rebel group.

episodes:554.name: The Berrisford Agenda
episodes:554.summary: Alec tries to right a wrong from his past after he realizes the former lover he was forced to assassinate may still be alive.

episodes:554.name: Borrowed Time
episodes:554.summary: Max and Logan make a run for romance after an antidote sends her virus into a 12-hour remission. But their hopes for a night of heat are cooled after Joshua crashes their reunion to report that a Manticore mutant is on the loose.

episodes:554.name: Harbor Lights
episodes:554.summary: A stray bullet sends Max to the ER, where her funky blood and DNA tests cause grave concern for the CDC---and Ames White's army. But as Logan races to get his girl to safety, a new threat emerges that could thrust Max into a governmental nightmare.

episodes:554.name: Love in Vein
episodes:554.summary: Max takes on a cult of superhuman blood addicts led by a Manticore mutant intent on rebuilding an X-5 army. Meanwhile, Joshua falls in with the wrong crowd after Alec dupes him into delivering his packages at Jam Pony.

episodes:554.name: Fuhgeddaboudit
episodes:554.summary: A telekinetic transgenic messes with Max's mind to keep her from coercing a meek mob bookie into selling out his boss to Eyes Only. But once the mutant sets her sights on Alec, the stakes are raised, leading him back into the boxing ring to make some money for some not-so-good fellas.

episodes:554.name: Exposure
episodes:554.summary: Max and Logan track Ames' kidnapped son to a small town where the breeding cult is readying Manticore's youngest creations for a mysterious ceremony. Meanwhile, Alec and Original Cindy take it upon themselves to stop Sketchy from uncovering the truth about the transgens running amok.

episodes:554.name: Hello, Goodbye
episodes:554.summary: After nearly infecting Logan, Max decides to end their affair for good; Alec's haunted by the sins of his Manticore twin; and White triggers a witch hunt by leaking info about the transgens to the media. Meanwhile, Joshua finds the perfect woman, but can't find the courage to confess his secret.

episodes:554.name: Dawg Day Afternoon
episodes:554.summary: Max must break her vow to avoid Logan after Joshua becomes a target of a transgenic manhunt in the sewers; White leaks news of the human-looking X-5s to the media, leading to a wide-scale attack against the so-called "monsters" running amok.

episodes:554.name: She Ain't Heavy
episodes:554.summary: Max's escape from Seattle is derailed after White sends in her clone to capture the elusive X-452; Logan's Eyes Only compound is attacked; Joshua finds a new home among his fellow mutants; and White takes the stand with a revelation sure to turn the entire nation against the transgens.

episodes:554.name: Love Among the Runes
episodes:554.summary: A bogus transgen lures Max into White's trap, where she learns the truth about the mystery marks appearing on her skin; the Terminal City dwellers mount a campaign to battle the humans hunting them down; Alec learns why Logan has been keeping his distance from his former friends.

episodes:554.name: Freak Nation
episodes:554.summary: The hunt for mutants leads to a hostage crisis at Jam Pony, where Max and company face not only violent vigilantes, but also White's killer corps of mutant hunters.

show:masters of the universe.name: Masters of the Universe: Revelation
show:masters of the universe.summary: A radical return to Eternia, Masters of the Universe: Revelation is a direct sequel series to the classic era of Masters of the Universe. Featuring fan-favorites He-Man, Orko, Cringer and Man-At-Arms, the story pits our heroic warriors and guardians of Castle Grayskull against Skeletor, Evil-Lyn, Beast Man and the vile legions of snake mountain! But after a ferocious final battle forever fractures Eternia, it's up to Teela to solve the mystery of the missing Sword of Power in a race against time to prevent the end of the Universe! Her journey will uncover the secrets of Grayskull at last. This is the epic He-Man and the Masters of the Universe saga fans have waited 35 years to see!

previousepisode.name: Comes with Everything You See Here

episodes:43428.name: The Power of Grayskull
episodes:43428.summary: Eternia celebrates Teela as its new Man-At-Arms, but the knighting ceremony is cut short when Skeletor leads a full-scale attack on Grayskull.

episodes:43428.name: Poisoned Chalice
episodes:43428.summary: Now mercenaries, Teela and her partner accept a job from a mysterious woman: to retrieve an old goblet from deep within Snake Mountain.

episodes:43428.name: The Most Dangerous Man in Eternia
episodes:43428.summary: While defending a village from Tri-Klops's cult, Teela's group meets Man-At-Arms, who is struggling to keep Orko alive using the town's magic water.

episodes:43428.name: Land of the Dead
episodes:43428.summary: Separated from her companions in Subternia, Teela faces a sinister entity who offers her half of the Sword of Power in exchange for her fears.

episodes:43428.name: The Forge at the Forest of Forever
episodes:43428.summary: A familiar figure warns Teela and the others that there may be no escape from Preternia. Roboto risks his mechanical body to reforge the Sword of Power.

episodes:43428.name: Cleaved in Twain
episodes:43428.summary: While the Sorceress, Adam and the others look on helplessly, Skeletor exploits his newfound power to evil lengths, plunging Eternia into chaos.

episodes:43428.name: Reason and Blood
episodes:43428.summary: Adam calls down the power of Grayskull without wielding the sword and clashes with Skeletor, then sets his sights on an improbable target.

episodes:43428.name: The Gutter Rat
episodes:43428.summary: As Evil-Lyn begins to doubt Skeletor's motives, she recalls how she first met the power-mad tyrant and ultimately decides to make an unexpected move.

episodes:43428.name: Hope, For a Destination
episodes:43428.summary: Aware of her legacy, Teela tries to manifest her powers to call for aid in their struggle against Evil-Lyn, while Adam partners with an unlikely ally.

episodes:43428.name: Comes with Everything You See Here
episodes:43428.summary: Teela assumes her new role and Adam reclaims the Sword of Power as the final confrontation for the fate of Eternia — and the entire universe — begins.

show:the andromeda strain.name: The Andromeda Strain
show:the andromeda strain.summary: In The Andromeda Strain, a U.S. military satellite crashes in a small town and unleashes a deadly plague killing all but two survivors. As the military quarantines the area, a team of highly specialized scientists is assembled to find a cure to the pathogen code-named "Andromeda," and a reporter investigates a government conspiracy only to discover what he is chasing wants him silenced.

episodes:3890.name: Part 1
episodes:3890.summary:
Workaholic Dr. Jeremy Stone has to initialize the top-secret national emergency plan he devices in a facility also planned by him when a mysterious, viciously rapid disease strikes a Utah backwater, actually after a small meteorite strike. His small team of scientists and specialized military doesn't realize one of them is in league with the infamous general George W. Mancheck, whose top-secret project is somehow entangled with the plague.

The plague-bringing 'meteorite' is found, actually a military satellite from general Manchek's top-secret project. Dr. Jeremy Stone's team works out the virulent organism found on it has 'alien' properties, yet its anatomy suggests lab-design. Tests on it and survivors study reveal radiation would only strengthen it, just before an atomic bomb is to be dropped, but the pilot is affected by the now bird of prey-spread organism.

episodes:3890.name: Part 2
episodes:3890.summary:
Dr. Jeremy Stone's team desperately examines the staggeringly rapid and radical mutations of the Andromeda organism, which thus obtains carriers and eats trough anything, even the pilot's breathing pipe so as to accidentally cause the atomic bomb to be dropped after all. At first sight purely academic speculation ranging from philosophy to astro-biology combined with observing the temporary survivors yield crucial findings of the sulfuric acid-based enemy. The organism is constructed, communicating like an ants army. Pountless detail in its design puzzles them, until the idea of a messenger function is varied to the organism being the medium, readable in ASCII because sent from the future. Meanwhile the military-political cover up plot thickens, and reporter Nash escapes.

Dr. Jeremy Stone's team successfully tests the bacteria-based cure, then decides to destroy all samples, fearing for communication, while racing against time to produce enough while the pest spreads. The military-political conspirators however blackmail a member to keep one, which frees itself and thus starts the auto-destruct, which proves extremely hard to shut down. Meanwhile escaped reporter Nash is chased by troops and the cover-up continues after the organism is eradicated.

show:the black cat.name: The Classroom of the Black Cat and a Witch
show:the black cat.summary: Spica Virgo is an apprentice witch, but can't use any magic. She needs someone to be her master in order to get into the academy of her dreams, but she has no money and no connections. Suddenly, a mysterious talking black cat that can use magic appears before her!! Spica wants to learn magic, and the black cat wants his curse broken—goals on the same path. Therefore, a secret master-apprentice relationship was born! But the key to breaking the curse is kissing his…?!

episodes:88915.name: Black Cat & Spica
episodes:88915.summary: Spica is trying to learn to become a master sorcerer. She has a long ways to go.

episodes:88915.summary: Claude comes up with a training plan for Spica, but it puts her in a bit of a bind.

show:the car.name: The Car Chasers
show:the car.summary: Buying a classic or exotic car, fixing it up and selling it equals profit. It seems like a good formula to make money, but it's not as easy as it sounds, to which Jeff Allen and Perry Barndt can attest. As they prove, it takes a certain type of person who's willing to take a gamble in order to make money in the car-flipping business, because a flip doesn't always result in profit. Jeff and Perry travel the country looking for cars they can buy low and eventually - they hope - sell high.
