show:dracula.name: Dracula
show:dracula.summary: In Transylvania in 1897, the blood drinking Count is drawing his plans against Victorian London. And be warned: the dead travel fast.

episodes:37453.name: The Rules of the Beast
episodes:37453.summary: 1897. English lawyer Jonathan Harker travels to Transylvania to meet a new client - and a legend is about to get fresh blood...

episodes:37453.name: Blood Vessel
episodes:37453.summary: The Russian ship The Demeter is a perfectly ordinary vessel, but her new voyage seems different. A motley collection of remarkable passengers includes one Count Dracula. Soon the crew are locked in a life-or-death struggle to stop the vampire before he reaches England. The ship of death has a new captain...

episodes:37453.name: The Dark Compass
episodes:37453.summary: Count Dracula has made it to England—a new world pulsing with fresh blood—and lays his plans to spread his foul vampire contagion. But why does he set his sights on the seemingly ordinary Lucy Westenra? And who on earth is left to stop him?

show:frankenstein.name: Frankenstein
show:frankenstein.summary: Adaption of Mary Shelley's novel about a scientist who brings life to a creature fashioned from corpses and various body parts.

show:house of frankenstein.name: House of Frankenstein
show:house of frankenstein.summary: Detective Coyle is trying to solve several bizarre murders and is having no luck finding a suspect. But when his girlfriend turns into a werewolf and gets kidnapped by a vampire, things start to fall into place...

show:the woods.name: Harlan Coben's The Woods
show:the woods.summary: Twenty years ago, Paul "Cope" Copeland's sister, Camille, vanished from a summer camp in the woods, a loss that tore his family apart. Now a top barrister and devoted single father to ten-year-old daughter Cami, Cope appears to have rebuilt his life. But when the body of a man turns up — twenty years after he was supposedly murdered alongside Camille — Cope becomes convinced his sister may have made it out of the woods alive too. Determined to uncover the truth, Cope begins a search for answers, unearthing years of lies, cover-ups, and family secrets that threaten to destroy everything he has built.

show:the hound of the baskervilles.name: The Hound of the Baskervilles
show:the hound of the baskervilles.summary: A 1982 dramatisation of the novel The Hound of the Baskervilles.

show:child s play.name: Child's Play
show:child s play.summary: Two contestants attempt to correctly guess words based on definitions given by children ages five to nine.

show:carrie.name: Carrie
show:carrie.summary: Carrie. A sheltered girl with telekinetic powers is bullied, leading to a horrific, bloody incident due to her domineering mother's influence.

show:navy seals.name: Navy SEALs: America's Secret Warriors
show:navy seals.summary: This is a four-hour, in-depth, behind-the-curtain look at the most prestigious fighting force in the world - the Navy Seals. From their inception in WWII (and the pivotal role the Seals played in D-Day) and through their missions in Vietnam, we trace the Seals rise to a watershed moment in 1980. After a failed government mission to rescue American hostages in Iran, Navy Seal Team Six - the elite of the elite - is formed. Seal Team Six is responsible for some of the most daring and iconic missions in U.S. military history, from the rescue of Captain Richard Phillips from Somali pirates to the epic take down of Osama Bin Laden. Their crucial role in the 21st century nature of war has made them a lethal team of highly-trained soldiers capable of executing missions anywhere in the world, at any time, against any enemy, and in near total secrecy.

episodes:25054.name: Part 1
episodes:25054.summary: The history of the SEALs' predecessors in World War II and the Korean War and their evolution into elite warriors, fighting in the jungles of Vietnam and executing secret missions in Panama and Grenada; the formation of SEAL Team 6.

episodes:25054.name: Part 2
episodes:25054.summary: The SEALs become the tip of the spear in the War on Terror, executing daily raids in Afghanistan and Iraq as well as high-profile missions, such as the rescue of Capt. Richard Phillips from pirates and the raid on Osama bin Laden's compound.

episodes:25054.name: Deadly Marksmen
episodes:25054.summary: Disciplined, determined, and deadly: Navy SEAL snipers may well be the most dangerous predators on earth. Their exhaustive training not only makes them world-class marksmen, but also experts in small arms combat under every conceivable condition. But most importantly, SEAL snipers develop the experience, judgement, and temperament to make split-second, life-or-death decisions: take the shot, or not?

episodes:25054.name: Enemy Territory
episodes:25054.summary: Before any enemy can be destroyed, it first has to be found. Reconnaissance is one of the SEALs' many areas of expertise. Their training includes extreme stealth, camouflage tactics and most importantly, operating on their own in hostile environments. SEAL SR teams remain invisible while gathering Intel on the target–then strike with lethal force when the moment is right. While the main purpose of reconnaissance is to hide and watch, SEAL history has shown this mission can turn deadly in an instant.

episodes:25054.name: Urban Combat
episodes:25054.summary: A terrorist insurgency turns Iraqi cities into cauldrons of violence, the Navy SEALs help turn the tide; the SEALs expertise in small-unit tactics, physical endurance and sheer grit make them an invaluable asset to the U.S. Army and Marines.

episodes:25054.name: Kill or Capture
episodes:25054.summary: The Navy SEALs pursue America's enemies all across the globe; they hunt down the worst of the worst and bring them to justice.

episodes:25054.name: Fallen Heroes
episodes:25054.summary: Extreme training and combat expertise are only part of what make the SEALs the world's most effective fighting force. What truly sets them apart is their warrior ethos: a code of honor combining courage, discipline, and unhesitating willingness to risk life and limb to accomplish the mission or aid a fallen fellow soldier. This ethos has been tested like never before over the last two decades, with relentless, unprecedented periods of combat in which the SEALs have played out an outsized role. Many SEALs carry permanent injuries, and many have lost their lives–but none of them regret helping defend their nation and their brothers in arms.

episodes:25054.name: Combat Rescue
episodes:25054.summary: Whether it is one of their own, or a civilian caught in the chaos of war, combat rescue is one of the most important–and dangerous–roles at which the Navy SEALs excel. Using the three traits they are best known for–speed, surprise and violence of action, the SEALs are sent across the globe to take on rescue missions few others would dare attempt. From the jungles of Vietnam to the mountains of Afghanistan, the SEALs have proved time and again that when it comes to risking their own lives to bring the good guys back home, they are a breed apart.

show:white lightning.name: Hatfields & McCoys: White Lightning
show:white lightning.summary: The battle between the Hatfields and McCoys is probably the most famous family feud in American history. Bad blood remains between the families more than a century later. But now the two clans are trying to put the past behind them and come together as the families' descendents have an opportunity that could rewrite history ... or keep their hatred going even longer. With moonshine legal in West Virginia, a liquor executive approaches Jim Quick, a maternal descendent of Randall McCoy, to propose a business partnership with the Hatfields to create a Hatfield and McCoy moonshine. The partnership would require Quick to work with Mark Hatfield, the great-great-great grandson of Devil Anse Hatfield, and the families to share their secret moonshine recipes with each other. This docuseries follows the families as they try to work together in a project that could net them millions.

episodes:13316.name: The Tale of Moonshine and Gasoline
episodes:13316.summary: With the changing of West Virginia Law, making and selling Moonshine has become legal and a big city Liquor Executive has been approaching members of the infamous Hatfield and McCoy clans looking to launch a new Moonshine Brand. Meanwhile, kin of Devil Anse Hatfield and Randall McCoy, are still squabbling after 150 years. Mark Hatfield and Jim McCoy get into a little tussle about who's moonshine is stronger and decide to settle the score by racing classic cars powered by their own brews.

episodes:13316.name: The Tale of the Moonshine Deal
episodes:13316.summary: Moonshine, coal and timber are still the best ways to make a living in the Tug River Valley, so it's no surprise that both Mark Hatfield and Jim McCoy want this moonshine liquor deal. In Kentucky, Jim is hosting a good ole' McCoy Hoedown to seal the deal with big liquor exec Monsell Darville. While in West Virginia, Mark Hatfield is throwing one of his legendary Bonfires to woo that liquor exec away from the McCoys. With the lucrative deal on the table, both Jim and Mark hope their shine will impresses Monsell enough to win the deal.

episodes:13316.name: Muscle Cars
episodes:13316.summary: The Hatfields and McCoys are in agreement for a change...they want nothing to do with each other or that big city liquor investor. Each family has decided to go out on their own and make their own legal moonshine. Problem is they still need to find the money to make it happen and of course make more of their product. Meanwhile, Jim McCoy is having some trouble with his lead foot mamma. Mama Irene is speeding around town in her Mustang and getting in trouble with the law.

episodes:13316.name: Moonshine Conspiracy
episodes:13316.summary: Scotty May Hatfield and Mickey McCoy join forces and are determined to get their families together to make this Moonshine deal happen with big liquor exec Monsell. If only Mark Hatfield and Jim McCoy can keep from fighting again. Meanwhile, James McCoy's has decided to test his family's DNA for a rage gene as his latest science experiment.

episodes:13316.name: Fishin' and Explosions
episodes:13316.summary: Jim McCoy and Mark Hatfield come to terms with liquor investor Monsell for a HatField & McCoy White Lightning. With the deal made, money advances given and promises made...Mark Hatfield and Jim McCoy now need to come through with the ancestral waters and a location for their Distillery before they can make one drop of the Hatfield & McCoy Moonshine.

episodes:13316.name: Still Explodin'
episodes:13316.summary: With the lease on the building already signed, Jim McCoy and Mark Hatfield have no choice but to start demolition on the new Hatfield and McCoy Distillery. Meanwhile, Jim and Mark entrust Scotty May to build the industrial sized still they will need to start makin' Moonshine.

episodes:13316.name: Double Crosser
episodes:13316.summary: With the clock ticking and Liquor Investor Monsell expecting a taste of Hatfield and McCoy Moonshine, Mark Hatfield frantically tries to replace the Still that Scotty May blew up. Meanwhile a frustrated Jim McCoy reaches out to John T. Hatfield about using his Still and cutting Mark out of the deal all together. Back in Kentucky, Mamaw Irene has a new weapon (toy) to keep the McCoy boys in line.

episodes:13316.name: The Double Agent
episodes:13316.summary: John and James McCoy hatch a plan to help both families and the Distillery get their Liquor Investor Monsell a taste of the Hatfield & McCoy Moonshine he's been waiting on. While John and James are busy building the much needed Still, they enlist a Hatfield to retrieve Devil Anse's secret Moonshine Recipe.

episodes:13316.name: Tug O' War
episodes:13316.summary: Liquor Investor Monsell is expecting a batch of Hatfields and McCoys Moonshine, but with no still, no recipe and no Hatfields, Jim McCoy had no choice but to lock the doors of the distillery. Now Jim's looking to get his frustrations out at the Annual Hatfield and McCoy Tug of War...only problem is that Mark and all the Hatfields are planning to boycott.

episodes:13316.name: The Devil You Know
episodes:13316.summary: With the Moonshine Still ready to go but no liquor investor, Mark Hatfield and Jim McCoy decide to work together and make Moonshine. First order of business is to get the proper licenses and of course the water. Meanwhile Liquor Investor Monsell tries to do business with other Hatfields and McCoys in the area and a paranoid Scotty May thinks the law is after him.

episodes:13316.name: Two Fools, One Recipe
episodes:13316.summary: When both Mark Hatfield and Jim McCoy refuse to share the family moonshine recipes Granny Billy and Mamaw Irene take matters into their own hands and enlist Scotty May and Mickey to retrieve the prized recipes. A concerned Monsell travels to West Virgina to check in on his investment, only to be given the run around by Courtney, John and James McCoy.

episodes:13316.name: The Big Taste
episodes:13316.summary: Now that there is a combined Hatfield and McCoy Moonshine recipe, Jim McCoy and Mark Hatfield get down to the business of makin' moonshine. But when there's a problem with the still, Jim and Mark are forced to find an alternate way to make the shine, so their liquor investor Monsell can have his much anticipated first taste.

episodes:13316.name: The Shoot Out
episodes:13316.summary: Mark Hatfield and Jim McCoy challenge each other to a shoot out to see who is the better marksman and most importantly who will pay for the door Scotty May ran into with a truck. Meanwhile, Mamaw Irene and Granny Billie have a shoot out of their own.

episodes:13316.name: The Grand Eviction
episodes:13316.summary: The families organize a special Hatfield & McCoy Demolition Derby to promote the Grand Opening of the Hatfield and McCoy Distillery. Meanwhile, Mark and Jim are shocked to find themselves locked out and served with an eviction notice from their new landlord. Leaving everyone to wonder if this Grand Opening is really going to happen?

show:gator.name: Wally Gator
show:gator.summary: Wally Gator is about Wally, an alligator who thinks that he is human. He is most satisfied when he is at the zoo, where his home is. Mr. Twiddles is the zookeeper that keeps an eye on Wally because sometimes, Wally escapes to see what life is like outside of his home. Characters Wally Gator (Daws Butler): Wally Gator enjoys staying at the zoo, but sometimes he just wants to see what the outside world is like. Mr. Twiddle (Don Messick): Mr. Twiddles is the zookeeper. He is always busy because he is trying to stop Wally from leaving the zoo. Wally Gator Opening Theme Wally Gator is a swinging alligator in the swamp, he's the greatest perculator when he really starts to romp. There has never been a greater operator in the swamp, see ya later, Wally Gator!

show:the mechanic.name: The Mechanical Universe... and Beyond
show:the mechanic.summary: Produced starting in 1985, the videos make heavy use of historical dramatizations and visual aids to explain physics concepts.

show:murphy s law.name: Murphy's Law
show:murphy s law.summary: Daedalus Patrick Murphy is a down-on-his-luck private eye who works for an insurance company, solving frauds and scams while trying to stay sober. He lives with a roommate, Kimiko Fannuchi, a Eurasian model who maintains their relationship is strictly platonic.

previousepisode.name: If Anything Can Go Wrong It Will

episodes:26220.name: The Room Above the Indian Grocery
episodes:26220.summary: Daedalus Patrick Murphy, a crack insurance investigator with a tainted past finds stability with a roommate, Kimiko. Murphy is a reformed alcoholic with three things on his mind - seeing his daughter, bedding his beautiful Eurasian roommate and avoiding all work. Murphy investigates the abrupt demise of an heiress who left $2 million to her husband.

episodes:26220.name: Where are My Socks and Other Mysteries of Love
episodes:26220.summary: A lady and his younger lover are the main suspects in a murder case that involved the owner of a fashion firm. Murphy must lead the lovers to confess the crime after his new boss demands more efficiency from the investigator.

episodes:26220.name: If You Can't Win, Shoot for a Tie
episodes:26220.summary: Murphy gets the chance to see the daughter (Sarah Sawatsky) he's never met by taking a missing-necklace case. Daedadelus Murphy, insurance investigator, is intrigued at the prospect of handling a case that involves his ex-wife, Marissa, because it will mean a meeting with Katherine, his daughter, after years of fighting for visitation rights. But first he's got to tackle two claims that on the surface seem simple, one involving a veterinarian and a ship's captain.

episodes:26220.name: Do Someone a Favor and It Becomes Your Job
episodes:26220.summary: Murphy gets into a quandary with several old bar cronies, two killers and the law while doing a favor for a former drinking buddy. Murphy gets involved in a murder coverup when he comes to the aid of an old drinking buddy who's in debt to a bookie.

episodes:26220.name: Never Play Leapfrog with a Unicorn
episodes:26220.summary: Murphy battles the loud nightclub he lives above and winds up in the middle of an FBI "sting" operation. Insurance investigator Murphy and his roomie, Kimiko, live above a nightclub. When the joint makes too much noise and disturbs their sleep. Murphy decides to try to close it down. That lands him in the midst of an FBI sting operation.

episodes:26220.name: Never Try to Teach a Pig to Sing
episodes:26220.summary: An arson investigator's too brief report about Ethiopian relief supplies makes Murphy suspect foul play.

episodes:26220.name: Two Wrongs are Only the Beginning
episodes:26220.summary: A stolen-motorcycle case vrooms through Murphy's life just as he's trying to become a model of stability for a family-court caseworker. One of Murphy's  claims becomes a lawsuit when Wes and Kimi steal a motorcycle.

episodes:26220.name: Never Wear Earmuffs in a Bed of Rattlesnakes
episodes:26220.summary: An irate claimant holds Kimi hostage in Murphy's office; Murphy's wife hires an investigator to plant microphones in his apartment.

episodes:26220.name: Where There's a Will, There's a Won't
episodes:26220.summary: Kimi and Murphy go to great lengths to get Wes to return to the job he chucked because of Victor, the obnoxious new acting vicepresident. However, even Victor is up for a surprise, a new vicepresident is appointed, an obnoxious woman named Morgana DeSade (she insists that it's Dyu-Shadá).

episodes:26220.name: When You're Over the Hill, You Pick Up Speed
episodes:26220.summary: Wes swears he will get rid of Morgana, the new vice-president, who is making everyone's lives miserable. Nevertheless, his death wish comes true and he winds up as the main suspect in her murder. Meanwhile, Murphy receives the visit of his unpleasant Aunt Cornellia, a mystery authoress. To help Wes, Murphy and Kimi hold a party for murder suspects to uncover the perpetrator of the murder.

episodes:26220.name: Experience is Something You Don't Get Until Just After You Need It
episodes:26220.summary: Murphy gets rights to see his daughter (Sarah Sawatsky), providing he keeps his job---and that depends on his nailing a fraud artist who marries illegal aliens and stages car wrecks on their honeymoons

episodes:26220.name: Doing It the Hard Way is Always Easier
episodes:26220.summary: Murphy gets rights to see his daughter, providing he keeps his job---and that depends on his nailing a fraud artist who marries illegal aliens and stages car wrecks on their honeymoons.

episodes:26220.name: If Anything Can Go Wrong It Will
episodes:26220.summary: During a charity event, a bejewelled egg is stolen. Murphy suspects the cat burglar may be the daughter of Kovac's, a renowned jewel thief. Suspiciously Marissa is behaving too kind to Murphy.

show:house of horrors.name: House of Horrors: Kidnapped
show:house of horrors.summary: One man's home, can be someone else's hell. House of Horrors: Kidnapped reveals terrifying tales of people who were kidnapped, yet were lucky enough to survive. Each episode centers on one person's ordeal. Starting from before the abduction right through to the hours, days, or months of captivity and finally to the escape and recovery as told by the victim in their own haunting recollection.

episodes:13726.name: The Dungeon Master
episodes:13726.summary: Kristen Baumer moves into her freshman dorm not far from home in Newark, DE. As the year comes to an end, she goes to a party with her girlfriends. Fun quickly turns to terror when her innocence is stolen by a man who haunts her until senior year.

episodes:13726.name: Field of Nightmares
episodes:13726.summary: Newly engaged Nikki Ansley starts work at a convenient store to purchase her fiancé's wedding ring. On her first day, two masked gunmen enter the store and kidnap her and two of her friends. After a night of terror, Nikki's life is changed forever.

episodes:13726.name: Prenatal Predator
episodes:13726.summary: Teka Adams was starting to turn her life around. She's thrilled when, at 9 months pregnant, she gets a call from a woman claiming to be a caseworker offering baby supplies. But Teka soon learns that the woman has something much more horrifying in mind.

episodes:13726.name: Pain & Gain
episodes:13726.summary: When successful Miami businessman Marc Schiller is ambushed by a gang of thugs in broad daylight, his nightmare is just beginning. Blindfolded and bound, Marc learns that the men hell-bent on killing him have a special kind of torture in store for him.

episodes:13726.name: Innocence Lost
episodes:13726.summary: Alicia Kozakiewicz was a typical 13-year old who made friends in chat rooms. But when she agreed to meet Scott Tyree in person, she had no idea he was a 38-year-old sadistic pedophile.

episodes:13726.name: The Toy Box Killer
episodes:13726.summary: Cynthia Vigil is a street-smart teen from Albuquerque... But a fateful meeting ends with Cynthia in chains and forced into the horrifying world of the Toy Box Killer a madman who, along with his girlfriend, subjects Cynthia to a world of torture and fear.

episodes:13726.name: Building Betrayal
episodes:13726.summary: Peter Brandt could never have predicted the dark secrets he would uncover when he invited a brilliant contractor into his home. After a vicious attack, Peter must manipulate the madman threatening his life into setting him free.

episodes:13726.name: Terror by the Letter
episodes:13726.summary: When Karen Kummerer's jilted ex-boyfriend takes her hostage on a terrifying, multi-state road trip, there is little hope for rescuing her alive. But Karen has a daring plan in her back pocket to keep the cops hot on their trail.

episodes:13726.name: The Road to Hell
episodes:13726.summary: Best friends Brandi and Liz are two small town teens who were taught to help others in need. So when a young man asks them for a ride to his house, they decide to oblige. But they soon discover the man intends for this to ride to be their last.

episodes:13726.name: The End of the Road
episodes:13726.summary: Sam and Suzzane Peebles were headed home after a long road trip in Arkansas. On the highway they spotted someone in need and pulled over to give him a ride. Little did they know the stranger was a wanted murderer. Will they suffer the same fate?

episodes:13726.name: A Madman Walks Into a Bar
episodes:13726.summary: When a crazed gunman storms into an East Village bar, Ann-Margret Gidley and her friends scramble for a way to escape. Trapped in a back room with no way out, Ann-Margret must summon a strength she didn't know she had to take down the shooter.

episodes:13726.name: Human Currency
episodes:13726.summary: When two young girls are coerced into a stranger's vehicle their lives will never be the same. In order to save their families the girls are forced to do unspeakable things until fate saves one of them while the other's life hangs in the balance.

episodes:13726.name: Spyder's Web
episodes:13726.summary: Natasha Herzig thinks she's landed the job of her dreams. Instead, she's been lured into a prostitution ring led by a violent pimp. After enduring a year as a sex slave, Natasha makes a daring move that risks her life but ends in freedom.

episodes:13726.name: Prisoner of Obsession
episodes:13726.summary: Brandi Baggett's relationship with her boyfriend quickly turns from a fairytale love story into an inescapable nightmare. Paul kidnaps Brandi and holds her at a farmhouse; it looks like she'll never get away, until she manipulates her way to freedom.

episodes:13726.name: Evil Intent
episodes:13726.summary: An innocent night out turns disastrous for Amy Hall when she is introduced to a handsome new guy in town named "Tex".  But once the two end up alone he shows his true colors. Tex abducts Amy, rapes her, and almost kills her before she can escape.

episodes:13726.name: They Called Him Animal
episodes:13726.summary: Rosalie Williams is small but tough. She has to be, working as a sheriff's dispatcher and jailer. But she still feels uneasy when murderer and rapist Jerry McFadden lands in her care and knocks out a deputy and takes her hostage.

episodes:13726.name: Last Shot
episodes:13726.summary: Diabetic Karen Maffucci couldn't have lived in a safer neighborhood. She doesn't think twice about being alone while her kids and husband are away. But that all changes when a man breaks into her home and kidnaps her at gunpoint without her insulin.

episodes:13726.name: Cartel from Hell
episodes:13726.summary: When three men abduct graduate student Ana Elizondo near the Mexican border, she thinks it's run of the mill border violence. But when Ana's captors inform her that her father owes them money, everything she thought she knew about him is questioned.

episodes:13726.name: Buried Alive
episodes:13726.summary: Michael Marshall is one of 26 kids that have been kidnapped by delusional thrill seekers. After being held in a buried truck for over a day, it looks like they will never see the light of day again. But Michael Marshall refuses to say "die."

episodes:13726.name: Evil Lives Here
episodes:13726.summary: When Laura Cowan's husband is sent to jail she has nowhere to turn. So when Musa Muhammad offers to help she thinks that her prayers have been answered. As time goes by, she realizes his motives are questionable but by then she is his prisoner.

episodes:13726.name: Hospital of Horrors
episodes:13726.summary: When a man bursts into nurse Margie Wyler's maternity ward, screaming and threatening members of the staff, she knows her first priority is the safety of her patients. What she doesn't realize is just how dangerous this man is.

episodes:13726.name: Murderous Masquerade
episodes:13726.summary: 18-year-old Jodie Gaines is confused, but compliant when a police car flags her down on a Tennessee back country road. However, as a plain clothed officer tells her to step out of the car, she doesn't realize she is stepping into her worst nightmare.

episodes:13726.name: Terrifying Odds
episodes:13726.summary: Bill Haley and his wife Christine decide to take a weekend trip to Atlantic City. They board a shuttle bus for what promises to be an uneventful ride,until the bus is hijacked by a crazed gunman. It's up to Bill to negotiate for the lives of the hostages.

episodes:13726.name: My Nightmare
episodes:13726.summary: Elsa Garcia was kidnapped as an infant from an orphanage. Her abductors are a preacher and his wife, who are far from holy. Elsa's life is an unending nightmare of chores and horrific abuse, until a shocking turn of events leads to the Combs' downfall.

episodes:13726.name: Sensory Recall
episodes:13726.summary: Shannon Woods is a small town girl with a bright future, when what seems like a routine traffic stop changes her life forever. Left to the mercy of a monster, she's stuck in a nightmare and will have to remember every detail if she's going to survive.

episodes:13726.name: Road Rage
episodes:13726.summary: 7-year-old Kristina Jacobson is taking the day off from school because of a minor injury. When a intruder breaks in, Kristina's free day soon turns into a nightmare filled with screams of terror, a rocket-like car ride, and a crash that defies gravity.

episodes:13726.name: Wrong Number
episodes:13726.summary: Single mom Kelly Finley comes home on a beautiful April day to go fishing with her two boys. But an unusual entrance from their next-door neighbor stops them short. Kelly finds herself trapped... protecting her sons from an evil intruder.

episodes:13726.name: Wired to Kill
episodes:13726.summary: 19-year old Jessica Vega is awoken by an old friend at her door asking for help. She agrees and his sadistic plan is set in motion. Jessica will soon find herself in a harrowing showdown with a sociopath that leads to the discovery of a ghastly crime.

episodes:13726.name: Judgment Day
episodes:13726.summary: A routine day at the office for Georgia attorney Mike Hostilo quickly becomes a harrowing nightmare when a hell bent, former client arrives with a bomb. After several hours of torture, Mike realizes the only way to survive will be to outsmart his captor.

episodes:13726.name: Unbroken
episodes:13726.summary: One night, 17-year-old Andrea Hood takes a ride as usual to survive the streets of Portland, Oregon. But she'll need all of her wits to escape the men who take her captive and begin making a soundproof chamber to keep her in forever.

episodes:13726.name: Hollywood Hells
episodes:13726.summary: When Jane Piper moved to LA to become an actress, she never imagined a trip to the grocery store would be the thing to change her life. A knife wielding maniac traps her in her own car -- and forces Jane to fight for her life.

episodes:13726.name: Murderer's Row
episodes:13726.summary: Larry Mendoza accepts a job as a corrections officer at the Penitentiary of New Mexico, deciding it is a risk worth taking for his family, then a routine headcount leads to one of the largest prison riots to date, confirming Mendoza's worst fears.

episodes:13726.name: Just One Kiss
episodes:13726.summary: Chuck Leonard and his girlfriend Kathy plan to enjoy a brisk, clear evening by taking a romantic drive. When unexpected visitors intrude on their plans, Chuck and Kathy get taken on a terrifying journey - and only one of them survives.

episodes:13726.name: Bus Stop
episodes:13726.summary: 19-year-old Jennifer Asbenson loves her job, but has trouble showing up on time. When she misses her bus again and is afraid of being fired, a Good Samaritan steps in to drive her. What seemed to be her guardian angel... quickly becomes her grim reaper.

episodes:13726.name: My Sister's Keeper
episodes:13726.summary: 19-year-old Wendy Morrison plans to see friends after her shift at the local diner, but she is kidnapped at gunpoint on the way. Forced to endure hours of brutal torture, Wendy must think quickly to save her life.

episodes:13726.name: Crazy in Love
episodes:13726.summary: On a smoke break at work, 19-year-old Karol Klei hears a familiar voice call her name and she turns to see a gun pointed at her face. To save herself from a contradicting madman, Karol is forced to manipulate the situation and run whenever she can.

show:the invisible man.name: The Invisible Man
show:the invisible man.summary: Darien Fawkes is a thief and conman with a scientist brother, Kevin. Kevin develops a gland that allows the implantee to excrete "Quicksilver" and turn invisible. Unfortunately, the gland has the side effect of rendering the implantee berserk if a counteragent isn't occasionally injected. Darien agrees to the operation to avoid a jail sentence. Terrorists kill Kevin, leaving Darien with the gland stuck in his head. A mysterious "Agency" was behind Kevin's research, and offer Darien a deal: work for them in return for injections of the Counteragent. Using his powers of invisibility, Darien takes on spies and other criminals for the government.

show:the battle of britain.name: The Battle of Britain: 3 Days That Saved the Nation
show:the battle of britain.summary:
In June 1940, a long hot summer lay ahead as a battle for national survival was fought in the skies over Britain. The programme explores the phases of the Battle of Britain and how it came to an end.

Dan Snow and Kate Humble present a three-part guide to the critical aerial battle that changed the course of the Second World War, featuring personal stories of pilots, ground crews and members of the public.

episodes:49000.name: The Few
episodes:49000.summary: Dan Snow and Kate Humble present a three-part guide to the critical aerial battle that changed the course of the Second World War, featuring personal stories of pilots, ground crews and members of the public. The first episode tracks the first skirmishes of the three-day battle,as the Luftwaffe began an all-out assault to rid Britain of air power prior to a land invasion. The first skirmishes were being tracked by a 19-year-old WAAF member in a secret London bunker, and her secret diaries provide fresh insight into the strategies behind the aerial combat.

show.name: The Battle of Britain: 3 Days That Saved the Nation

episodes:49000.name: The Darkest Hour
episodes:49000.summary: Dan Snow and Kate Humble tell the story of August 30, 1940 - the RAF's most intense day of fighting across the whole battle, as Britain's airfields came under severe threat. Young armourer Ronald Pountain reported for another day of nerve-wracking duty, and seven decades later he can still recall the anxious wait for his pilots to return from their terrifying encounters with the enemy.

show.name: The Battle of Britain: 3 Days That Saved the Nation

episodes:49000.name: The Blitz
episodes:49000.summary: Dan Snow and Kate Humble conclude their guide to aerial battle that changed the course of the Second World War. Here they tell the story of September 15, 1940 - the most decisive day in the battle for the RAF. With Hitler's plan to invade just days away, Britain's pilots had a final chance to save the nation against the Luftwaffe.

show:phantom of the opera.name: The Phantom of the Opera
show:phantom of the opera.summary: Count de Chagnie has discovered Christine's singing talent on a market place and sent her to his friend Carriere, the director of the Parisian opera. However just when she arrives Carriere's dismissed. His arrogant successor refuses to let a woman of low birth sing in his opera, but graciously employs Christine as gadrobiere for his wife Charlotta, who's installed as first singer. He also fights the phantom, an unknown guy who lives since many years in the catacombs below the opera and was granted privileges by Carriere. However the phantom knows how to defend himself and at the same time helps Christine to her career.

show:she wolf of london.name: She-Wolf of London
show:she wolf of london.summary: While touring the UK and planning to meet mythology professor Ian Matheson, graduate student Randi Wallace is bitten by a werewolf. Now when the full is moon, Randi transforms into a werewolf herself. With the aid of Ian and his unwitting family, Randi and Ian investigate other supernatural incidents in England. After 14 episodes, the joint-production UK/American crew migrated to L.A. where Ian got a job as a talk-show host and acquired an agent, Skip Seville. The show was retitled Love and Curses, and was cancelled after six more episodes.
